title.zh: 卷一百四十三 志第九十六 儀衞一
title.raw: 卷一百四十三 志第九十六 儀衞一 Volume 143 Treatises 96: Ceremonial Guards 1

sentences.zh: 儀衛一○殿庭立仗

translations.literal: Ceremonial Guards 1 · Court guard formations in the hall
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial Guards, Part 1: Guard Formations in the Palace Courtyard

sentences.zh: 綦天下之貴，一人而已。

translations.literal: Extremely under Heaven honored, one person only.
translations.idiomatic: Of all honor under Heaven, there is only one person.

sentences.zh: 是故環拱而居，備物而動，文謂之儀，武謂之衛。

translations.literal: Therefore encircled bowing dwelling, prepare things then move, civil called yi, martial called wei.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore he sits encompassed [by attendants] and moves forth with full accoutrements: the civil aspect is called ceremony (yi), the martial aspect is called guard (wei).

sentences.zh: 一以明制度，示等威；

translations.literal: One part to clarify institutions, show graded majesty;
translations.idiomatic: In one respect to clarify institutions and display graded majesty;

sentences.zh: 一以慎出入，遠危疑也。

translations.literal: One part to careful exit enter, distance danger doubt.
translations.idiomatic: in another to be careful in going out and coming in and to keep danger and suspicion at a distance.

sentences.zh: 《書》載弁戈、冕劉、虎賁、車輅。

translations.literal: Book records cap halberd, ceremonial cap Liu, tiger guard, chariot carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Documents records cap and halberd, ceremonial cap and tassels, tiger guards, and the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 《周官》旅賁，王出入，執盾以夾王車。

translations.literal: Rites of Zhou host tiger guard, king exit enter, hold shield to flank king chariot.
translations.idiomatic: In the Rites of Zhou, the host of tiger guards: when the king went out or in, they grasped shields to flank the royal chariot.

sentences.zh: 朝儀之製，固已粲然。

translations.literal: Court ceremony system, solid already brilliant.
translations.idiomatic: The form of court ceremony was already fully elaborated.

sentences.zh: 降及秦、漢，始有周廬、陛戟、鹵簿、金根、大駕、法駕千乘萬騎之盛。

translations.literal: Descending reaching Qin Han, first had perimeter guard, hall halberd, processional train, gold root, grand carriage, law carriage thousand chariots myriad riders splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Down through the Qin and Han, there first appeared the grandeur of perimeter guards, hall halberds, imperial processional trains, gold-root chariots, grand carriage entourages, and law-carriage processions with thousands of chariots and myriads of horsemen.

sentences.zh: 曆代因之，雖或損益，然不過為尊大而已。

translations.literal: Successive dynasties followed it, although perhaps reduce increase, yet not exceed for honor great only.
translations.idiomatic: Successive dynasties followed this; though they sometimes reduced or augmented it, it amounted to nothing more than making it more imposing.

sentences.zh: 宋初，因唐、五代之舊，講究修葺，尤為詳備。

translations.literal: Song beginning, following Tang Five Dynasties old, study repair, especially detailed complete.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Song, following the precedents of Tang and the Five Dynasties, they studied and repaired the system, making it especially detailed and complete.

sentences.zh: 其殿庭之儀，則有黃麾大仗、黃麾半仗、黃麾角仗、黃麾細仗。

translations.literal: Its hall court ceremony, then has yellow banner great guard, yellow banner half guard, yellow banner corner guard, yellow banner fine guard.
translations.idiomatic: For ceremony in the palace hall courtyard, there were the great yellow-banner guard formation, half yellow-banner formation, corner yellow-banner formation, and detailed yellow-banner formation.

sentences.zh: 凡正旦、冬至及五月一日大朝會，大慶、冊、受賀、受朝，則設大仗；

translations.literal: All New Year winter solstice and fifth month first day great court assembly, great celebration investiture book receive felicitation receive homage, then deploy great guard;
translations.idiomatic: For New Year's Day, the winter solstice, and the grand court assembly on the first day of the fifth month, and for great celebrations, investiture book ceremonies, receipt of felicitations, and receipt of homage, the great formation was deployed;

sentences.zh: 月朔視朝，則設半仗；

translations.literal: Month new moon view court, then deploy half guard;
translations.idiomatic: for the monthly new-moon audience, the half formation was deployed;

sentences.zh: 外國使來，則設角仗；

translations.literal: Foreign state envoy come, then deploy corner guard;
translations.idiomatic: when envoys from foreign states came, the corner formation was deployed;

sentences.zh: 發冊授寶，則設細仗。

translations.literal: Issue book confer seal, then deploy fine guard.
translations.idiomatic: when issuing the investiture book and conferring the seal, the detailed formation was deployed.

sentences.zh: 其鹵簿之等有四：一曰大駕，郊祀大饗用之；

translations.literal: Its processional train grades have four: one called grand carriage, suburban sacrifice great feast use it;
translations.idiomatic: The grades of the imperial processional train were four: first, the grand carriage entourage, used for suburban sacrifice and great feasts;

sentences.zh: 二曰法駕，方澤、明堂、宗廟、籍田用之；

translations.literal: Two called law carriage, square mound Bright Hall ancestral temple plowing field use it;
translations.idiomatic: second, the law carriage, used for the square mound altar, Bright Hall, ancestral temple, and plowing ceremony;

sentences.zh: 三曰小駕，朝陵、封祀、奏謝用之；

translations.literal: Three called small carriage, attend tomb seal sacrifice present thanks use it;
translations.idiomatic: third, the small carriage entourage, used for attending the imperial tombs, sealing-off sacrifices, and presenting thanks;

sentences.zh: 四曰黃麾仗，親征、省方還京用之。

translations.literal: Four called yellow banner guard, personal campaign inspect realm return capital use it.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, the yellow-banner guard train, used when the emperor personally campaigned or returned to the capital after touring the realm.

sentences.zh: 南渡之後，務為簡省。

translations.literal: South crossing after, strive for simple economize.
translations.idiomatic: After the move south across the Yangzi, the court strove for simplification and economy.

sentences.zh: 此其大較也。

translations.literal: This its great outline.
translations.idiomatic: This is the general outline.

sentences.zh: 若夫臨時增損，用置不同，則有國史、會要、禮書具在。

translations.literal: As for temporary increase decrease, deploy place not same, then has national history essentials ritual books all present.
translations.idiomatic: As for temporary additions and reductions, with differing deployment, the National History, Essential Documents, and ritual compilations record them fully.

sentences.zh: 今取所載。

translations.literal: Now take what recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Here what is recorded is selected.

sentences.zh: 撮其凡為《儀衛志》。

translations.literal: Gather its outline as Treatise on Ceremonial Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Its outlines are gathered into this "Treatise on Ceremonial Guards."

sentences.zh: 殿庭立仗，本充庭之製。

translations.literal: Hall court standing guard, originally fill court system.
translations.idiomatic: Court guard formations in the hall courtyard were originally the system for filling the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 唐禮，殿庭、屯門，皆列諸衛黃麾大仗。

translations.literal: Tang ritual, hall court garrison gate, all array each guard yellow banner great guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang ritual, in the hall courtyard and at the gate where troops were stationed, each guard unit deployed the yellow-banner great formation.

sentences.zh: 宋興，太祖增創錯繡諸旗並幡氅等，著於《通禮》，正、至、五月一日，禦正殿則陳之。

translations.literal: Song rise, Taizu increase create brocade embroidered various flags together pennant streamer etc., recorded in Comprehensive Rituals, New Year solstice fifth month first day, hold main hall then display them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song arose, Taizu newly added brocaded and embroidered banners together with pennants and streamers, recorded in the Comprehensive Rituals; on New Year's Day, the solstice, and the first of the fifth month, when he held court in the main hall, these were displayed.

sentences.zh: 青龍、白虎旗各一，分左右；

translations.literal: Azure Dragon White Tiger flags each one, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: One Azure Dragon banner and one White Tiger banner each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 五嶽旗五在左，五星旗五在右；

translations.literal: Five Sacred Peaks flags five at left, Five Stars flags five at right;
translations.idiomatic: five Five Sacred Peaks banners on the left, five Five Stars banners on the right;

sentences.zh: 五方龍旗二十五在左，五方鳳旗二十五在右；

translations.literal: Five direction dragon flags twenty-five at left, five direction phoenix flags twenty-five at right;
translations.idiomatic: twenty-five dragon banners of the five directions on the left, twenty-five phoenix banners of the five directions on the right;

sentences.zh: 紅門神旗二十八，分左右；

translations.literal: Red gate spirit flags twenty-eight, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: twenty-eight Red Gate spirit banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 朱雀、真武旗各一，分左右；

translations.literal: Vermilion Bird True Warrior flags each one, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: one Vermilion Bird banner and one True Warrior banner each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 皂纛十二，分左右。

translations.literal: Black banners twelve, divide left right.
translations.idiomatic: twelve black great banners, divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 〈（以上金吾。）〉

translations.literal: (Above Jinwu.)
translations.idiomatic: (The above: Jinwu Guard.)

sentences.zh: 天一、太一旗各一，分左右；

translations.literal: Heaven One Grand One flags each one, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: One Heaven One banner and one Grand One banner each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 攝提旗二，分左右；

translations.literal: Sheti flags two, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: two Sheti banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 五辰旗五，北斗旗一，分左右；

translations.literal: Five chronograms flags five, Northern Dipper flag one, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: five Five Chronograms banners and one Northern Dipper banner, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 〈（木、火、北斗在左，金、水、土在右。）〉

translations.literal: (Wood fire Northern Dipper at left, metal water earth at right.)
translations.idiomatic: (Wood, fire, and the Northern Dipper on the left; metal, water, and earth on the right.)

sentences.zh: 二十八宿各一，

translations.literal: Twenty-eight lodges each one,
translations.idiomatic: one banner for each of the Twenty-eight Lodges,

sentences.zh: 〈（角宿至壁宿在左，奎宿至軫宿在右。）〉

translations.literal: (Horn lodge to Wall lodge at left, Stride lodge to Chariot lodge at right.)
translations.idiomatic: (From the Horn lodge to the Wall lodge on the left; from the Stride lodge to the Chariot lodge on the right.)

sentences.zh: 風伯、雨師旗各一，分左右；

translations.literal: Wind Lord Rain Master flags each one, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: one Wind Lord banner and one Rain Master banner each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 白澤、馴象、仙鹿、玉兔、馴犀、金鸚鵡、瑞麥、孔雀、野馬、犛牛旗各二，分左右；

translations.literal: White Marsh tame elephant immortal deer jade rabbit tame rhinoceros gold parrot auspicious wheat peacock wild horse yak flags each two, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: two each of the White Marsh, tame elephant, immortal deer, jade rabbit, tame rhinoceros, golden parrot, auspicious wheat, peacock, wild horse, and yak banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 日月合璧旗一，在左；

translations.literal: Sun moon joined disk flag one, at left;
translations.idiomatic: one Sun-and-Moon Joined Disk banner, on the left;

sentences.zh: 五星連珠旗一，在右；

translations.literal: Five stars linked pearl flag one, at right;
translations.idiomatic: one Five Stars Linked as Pearls banner, on the right;

sentences.zh: 雷公、電母旗各一，分左右；

translations.literal: Thunder Duke Lightning Mother flags each one, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: one Thunder Duke banner and one Lightning Mother banner each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 軍公旗六，分左右；

translations.literal: Military Duke flags six, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: six Military Duke banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 黃鹿、飛麟、兕、騶牙、白狼、蒼烏、辟邪、網子、貔旗各二，分左右；

translations.literal: Yellow deer flying qilin rhinoceros zouya white wolf dark crow ward evil net zi pi flags each two, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: two each of the yellow deer, flying qilin, rhinoceros, zouya, white wolf, dark crow, ward-off-evil, net, and pi banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 信幡二十二，分左右；

translations.literal: Trust pennants twenty-two, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: twenty-two trust pennants, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 傳教、告止幡各十二，分左右；

translations.literal: Transmit teaching halt banners each twelve, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: twelve transmit-teaching banners and twelve halt banners each, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 黃麾二，分左右。

translations.literal: Yellow banners two, divide left right.
translations.idiomatic: two yellow banners, divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 〈（以上兵部。）〉

translations.literal: (Above Ministry of War.)
translations.idiomatic: (The above: Ministry of War.)

sentences.zh: 日旗、月旗各一，分左右；

translations.literal: Sun flag moon flag each one, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: one sun banner and one moon banner each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 君王萬歲旗一在左；

translations.literal: Monarch ten thousand years flag one at left;
translations.idiomatic: one "My Lord, Ten Thousand Years" banner on the left;

sentences.zh: 天下太平旗一，在右；

translations.literal: Under Heaven great peace flag one, at right;
translations.idiomatic: one "Great Peace Under Heaven" banner, on the right;

sentences.zh: 獅子旗二，分左右；

translations.literal: Lion flags two, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: two lion banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 金鸞、金鳳旗各一，分左右；

translations.literal: Golden luan golden phoenix flags each one, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: one golden luan banner and one golden phoenix banner each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 五方龍旗各一。

translations.literal: Five direction dragon flags each one.
translations.idiomatic: one dragon banner for each of the five directions.

sentences.zh: 〈（青、赤在左，黃、白、黑在右。

translations.literal: (Azure red at left, yellow white black at right.
translations.idiomatic: (Azure and red on the left; yellow, white, and black on the right.

sentences.zh: 以上龍墀。）〉

translations.literal: Above dragon terrace.)
translations.idiomatic: The above: dragon terrace.)

sentences.zh: 龍君、虎君旗各五，分左右；

translations.literal: Dragon lord tiger lord flags each five, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: five dragon-lord banners and five tiger-lord banners each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 赤豹、黃羆旗各五，分左右；

translations.literal: Red leopard yellow bear flags each five, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: five red leopard banners and five yellow bear banners each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 小黃龍旗一，在左；

translations.literal: Small yellow dragon flag one, at left;
translations.idiomatic: one small yellow dragon banner, on the left;

sentences.zh: 天馬旗一，在右；

translations.literal: Heaven horse flag one, at right;
translations.idiomatic: one heaven horse banner, on the right;

sentences.zh: 吏兵、力士旗各五，分左右；

translations.literal: Official soldier strongman flags each five, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: five official-soldier banners and five strongman banners each, positioned left and right;

sentences.zh: 天王旗四，分左右；

translations.literal: Heaven king flags four, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: four heaven king banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 太歲旗十二，分左右；

translations.literal: Grand Year flags twelve, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: twelve Grand Year banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 天馬旗六，分左右；

translations.literal: Heaven horse flags six, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: six heaven horse banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 排闌旗六十，分左右；

translations.literal: Gate-clearing flags sixty, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: sixty gate-clearing banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 左右幡氅各五行，行七十五；

translations.literal: Left right pennant streamers each five rows, row seventy-five;
translations.idiomatic: five rows of pennants and streamers on the left and right, seventy-five per row;

sentences.zh: 大黃龍旗二，分左右；

translations.literal: Great yellow dragon flags two, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: two great yellow dragon banners, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 大神旗六，分左右。

translations.literal: Great spirit flags six, divide left right.
translations.idiomatic: six great spirit banners, divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 〈（以上六軍。）〉

translations.literal: (Above Six Armies.)
translations.idiomatic: (The above: Six Armies.)

sentences.zh: 神宗元豐二年，詳定所言：“正旦禦殿，合用黃麾仗。

translations.literal: Shenzong Yuanfeng year two, detailed regulation office stated: "New Year hold hall, should use yellow banner guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanfeng under Emperor Shenzong, the office for detailed regulations stated: "For holding court on New Year's Day, the yellow-banner guard formation should be used.

sentences.zh: 案唐《開元禮》，冬至朝會及皇太子受冊、加元服，冊命諸王大臣，朝宴外國，亦皆用之。

translations.literal: Case Tang Kaiyuan Rituals, winter solstice court assembly and crown prince receive book add capping, book appoint various kings great ministers, court feast foreign states, also all use it.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Tang Kaiyuan Rituals, the winter solstice court assembly, the crown prince's receipt of the investiture book and capping, the appointment by book of kings and great ministers, court feasts for foreign states—all likewise used it.

sentences.zh: 故事，皇帝受群臣上尊號，諸衛各率其屬，勒所部屯門、殿庭列仗衛。

translations.literal: Precedent, emperor receive hundred officials upward honor title, various guards each lead their subordinates, restrain their department garrison gate hall court array guard.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, when the emperor received from the hundred officials an upward honorific title, each guard unit led its subordinates and deployed its section at the garrison gate and in the hall courtyard as guard formations.

sentences.zh: 今獨修正旦儀注，而餘皆未及。

translations.literal: Now alone revise New Year ritual notes, yet remainder all not yet reach.
translations.idiomatic: At present only the New Year's Day ritual regulations were revised, while the rest had not yet been addressed.

sentences.zh: 欲乞冬會等儀，悉加詳定。”

translations.literal: Wish beg winter assembly etc. ceremony, all add detailed fix."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the winter assembly and other ceremonies likewise be fully detailed and fixed."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: Edict follow it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this.

sentences.zh: 又言：“禦殿儀仗，有黃麾幡三而無黃麾。

translations.literal: Again stated: "Hold hall ritual accoutrements, have yellow banner pennants three yet no yellow banner.
translations.idiomatic: They also stated: "For ritual accoutrements when holding court, there were three yellow-banner pennants but no yellow banner.

sentences.zh: 請製大麾一，注旄於幹首，以取夏製；

translations.literal: Request make great banner one, inscribe yak tail on pole head, to take Xia system;
translations.idiomatic: We request that one great banner be made, with yak tail affixed to the pole head, following the Xia system;

sentences.zh: 黃色，以取漢製；

translations.literal: Yellow color, to take Han system;
translations.idiomatic: yellow in color, following the Han system;

sentences.zh: 用十二幅，以取唐製；

translations.literal: Use twelve panels, to take Tang system;
translations.idiomatic: using twelve panels, following the Tang system;

sentences.zh: 用一旒，以取今龍墀旗之製。

translations.literal: Use one tassel, to take present dragon terrace flag system.
translations.idiomatic: using one tassel, following the present system of dragon-terrace flags.

sentences.zh: 建於當禦廂之前，以為表識。

translations.literal: Erect at facing hall wing front, to be marker sign.
translations.idiomatic: It would be erected before the wing where the emperor faced court, as a marker.

sentences.zh: 其當禦廂之後，則建黃麾幡二。”

translations.literal: Its facing hall wing behind, then erect yellow banner pennants two."
translations.idiomatic: Behind the wing where the emperor faced court, two yellow-banner pennants would be erected."

sentences.zh: 上謂蔡確等曰：“黃麾制度，終有可疑。

translations.literal: Emperor told Cai Que etc. said: "Yellow banner system, ultimately have doubtful.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to Cai Que and others: "The yellow-banner system still had doubtful points.

sentences.zh: 今鑿而為植於大庭，夷夏共瞻，或致博聞多識者譏議，非善，宜姑闕之。”

translations.literal: Now chisel then plant in great court, barbarian and Chinese together gaze, perhaps cause broad heard many know person ridicule discuss, not good, should for now omit it."
translations.idiomatic: To carve it out now and plant it in the great courtyard, for barbarians and Chinese alike to behold, might invite ridicule from the widely learned—this would not be good; it would be better to leave it out for the time being."

sentences.zh: 乃止。

translations.literal: Then stop.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was then dropped.

sentences.zh: 三年，詳定所言：“昨定朝會圖，於大慶殿橫街北止陳大輦、逍遙、平輦，而輿未陳也。

translations.literal: Year three, detailed regulation office stated: "Yesterday fixed court assembly diagram, at Great Celebration Hall cross street north stop display great palanquin leisure flat palanquin, yet sedan not yet displayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the office for detailed regulations stated: "When the court assembly diagram was fixed yesterday, north of the cross street at Great Celebration Hall only the great palanquin, leisure palanquin, and flat palanquin were displayed, but the sedans had not yet been shown.

sentences.zh: 當大輦之南，增腰輿一，小輿一。

translations.literal: At great palanquin south, increase waist sedan one, small sedan one.
translations.idiomatic: South of the great palanquin, one waist sedan and one small sedan should be added.

sentences.zh: 古者扇翣，皆編次雉羽或尾為之，故於文從‘羽’。

translations.literal: Ancient fan canopy, all woven order pheasant feather or tail make it, therefore in writing follow 'feather'.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity, fans and canopies were all woven in sequence from pheasant feathers or tails; hence in writing the character follows "feather."

sentences.zh: 唐《開元》改為孔雀，凡大朝會，陳一百五十有六，分居左右。

translations.literal: Tang Kaiyuan changed to peacock, all great court assembly, display one hundred fifty six, separate dwell left right.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang Kaiyuan Rituals changed these to peacock [feathers]; at every great court assembly, one hundred fifty-six were displayed, divided between left and right.

sentences.zh: 國朝復雉尾之名，而四面略為羽毛之形，中繡雙孔雀，又有雙盤龍扇，皆無所本。”

translations.literal: Our dynasty restore pheasant tail name, yet four sides slightly feather shape, middle embroider pair peacock, again have pair coiled dragon fan, all without source."
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty restored the name "pheasant tail," yet on four sides it was slightly in the shape of feathers, with a pair of peacocks embroidered in the center; there were also paired coiled-dragon fans—all without clear precedent."

sentences.zh: 遂改製偏扇、團方扇為三等，繡雉。

translations.literal: Then changed make partial fan round square fan into three grades, embroider pheasant.
translations.idiomatic: They therefore redesigned the partial fans and round square fans into three grades, embroidered with pheasants.

sentences.zh: 凡朝會，平輦、逍遙並陳於東西龍墀上。

translations.literal: All court assembly, flat palanquin leisure together display at east west dragon terrace above.
translations.idiomatic: At every court assembly, the flat palanquin and leisure palanquin were displayed together on the dragon terrace east and west.

sentences.zh: 徽宗政和三年，議禮局上大慶殿大朝會儀衛：

translations.literal: Huizong Zhenghe year three, discuss ritual office submit Great Celebration Hall great court assembly ceremonial guard:
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenghe under Emperor Huizong, the Office for Discussing Rituals submitted the ceremonial guard for the great court assembly at Great Celebration Hall:

sentences.zh: 黃麾大仗五千二十五人。

translations.literal: Yellow banner great guard five thousand twenty-five persons.
translations.idiomatic: The great yellow-banner guard formation: five thousand twenty-five persons.

sentences.zh: 仗首左右廂各二部，絳引幡十。

translations.literal: Guard head left right wing each two sections, crimson guide pennants ten.
translations.idiomatic: At the head of the guard formation, each left and right wing had two sections and ten crimson guide pennants.

sentences.zh: 〈（執各一人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each held by one person.)
translations.idiomatic: (Each [item] held by one person.)

sentences.zh: 第一部，左右領軍衛大將軍各一員，第二部，左右領軍衛折衝，掌鼓一人，帥兵官一十人。

translations.literal: First section, left right Lead Army Guard great general each one officer, second section, left right Lead Army Guard assault commander, beat drum one person, lead troop officer ten persons.
translations.idiomatic: First section: one great general of the Left and Right Lead Army Guards each; second section: assault commanders of the Left and Right Lead Army Guards, one drum beater, and ten troop-leading officers.

sentences.zh: 次執儀刀部十二行，每行持各十人：

translations.literal: Next hold ritual blade section twelve rows, each row holders each ten persons:
translations.idiomatic: Next, twelve rows of the section bearing ritual blades, ten holders in each row:

sentences.zh: 〈（後部並仗同。）〉

translations.literal: (Rear sections and guard formation likewise.)
translations.idiomatic: (The rear sections and guard formation were the same.)

sentences.zh: 第一行，黃雞四角氅；

translations.literal: First row, yellow chicken four-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: First row: four-corner streamers with yellow chickens;

sentences.zh: 〈（凡氅，皆持以龍頭竿。）〉

translations.literal: (All streamers, all held on dragon-head poles.)
translations.idiomatic: (All streamers were held on dragon-head poles.)

sentences.zh: 第二，儀鍠五色幡；

translations.literal: Second, ritual gong five-color pennants;
translations.idiomatic: Second: five-colored pennants with ritual gongs;

sentences.zh: 第三，青孔雀五角氅；

translations.literal: Third, azure peacock five-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Third: five-corner streamers with azure peacocks;

sentences.zh: 第四，烏戟；

translations.literal: Fourth, black halberd;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: black halberds;

sentences.zh: 第五，緋鳳六角氅；

translations.literal: Fifth, scarlet phoenix six-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: six-corner streamers with scarlet phoenixes;

sentences.zh: 第六，細弓矢；

translations.literal: Sixth, fine bow arrows;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: fine bows and arrows;

sentences.zh: 第七，白鵝四角氅；

translations.literal: Seventh, white goose four-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: four-corner streamers with white geese;

sentences.zh: 第八，朱縢絡盾刀；

translations.literal: Eighth, vermilion cord net shield sword;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth: swords with vermilion-cord net shields;

sentences.zh: 第九，皂鵝六角氅；

translations.literal: Ninth, black goose six-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Ninth: six-corner streamers with black geese;

sentences.zh: 第十，細弓矢；

translations.literal: Tenth, fine bow arrows;
translations.idiomatic: Tenth: fine bows and arrows;

sentences.zh: 第十一，槊；

translations.literal: Eleventh, spear;
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh: spears;

sentences.zh: 第十二，綠縢絡盾刀。

translations.literal: Twelfth, green cord net shield sword.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth: swords with green-cord net shields.

sentences.zh: 揭鼓二，掌鼓二人。

translations.literal: Reveal drum two, beat drum two persons.
translations.idiomatic: Two reveal drums and two drum beaters.

translations.literal: (Rear section same.)
translations.idiomatic: (Same in the rear section.)

sentences.zh: 以上排列左右廂。

translations.literal: Above array left right wing.
translations.idiomatic: The above were arrayed in the left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 第一部各於軍員之南，居次廂第一部稍前。

translations.literal: First section each at military officer south, dwell second wing first section slightly front.
translations.idiomatic: Each first section stood south of its military officer, positioned slightly ahead of the first section of the next wing.

sentences.zh: 第二部於第一部之後，並相向。

translations.literal: Second section at first section behind, together face each other.
translations.idiomatic: Each second section stood behind its first section, facing one another.

sentences.zh: 次廂左右各三部：第一，左右屯衛；

translations.literal: Next wing left right each three sections: first, left right Garrison Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Each wing next had three sections on left and right: first, the Left and Right Garrison Guards;

sentences.zh: 第二，左右武衛，並大將軍；

translations.literal: Second, left right Martial Guard, together great general;
translations.idiomatic: second, the Left and Right Martial Guards, each with a great general;

sentences.zh: 第三，左右衛將軍：各一員。

translations.literal: Third, left right Guard generals: each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: third, generals of the Left and Right Guards: one officer each.

sentences.zh: 第一，果毅；

translations.literal: First, stalwart;
translations.idiomatic: First: stalwart officers;

sentences.zh: 第二、第三，折衝：各一員。

translations.literal: Second third, assault commander: each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: second and third: assault commanders, one officer each.

sentences.zh: 於仗首左右廂第一部之南，相向。

translations.literal: At guard head left right wing first section south, face each other.
translations.idiomatic: They stood south of the first section of each wing at the head of the guard formation, facing one another.

sentences.zh: 持黃麾幡二人，在當禦廂前分立。

translations.literal: Hold yellow banner pennants two persons, at facing hall wing front separate stand.
translations.idiomatic: Two persons holding yellow-banner pennants stood separately before the wing where the emperor faced court.

sentences.zh: 當禦廂左右各一部，左右衛果毅各一人，於玉輅之前分左右，並北向。

translations.literal: Facing hall wing left right each one section, left right Guard stalwart each one person, at jade carriage before divide left right, together north face.
translations.idiomatic: At each side of the facing hall wing, one section each: one stalwart officer of the Left and Right Guards apiece, divided left and right before the jade carriage, all facing north.

sentences.zh: 次後廂左右各三部：第一，左右驍衛將軍；

translations.literal: Next rear wing left right each three sections: first, left right Martial Guard generals;
translations.idiomatic: Next, each rear wing had three sections on left and right: first, generals of the Left and Right Martial Guards;

sentences.zh: 第二，左右領軍衛折衝；

translations.literal: Second, left right Lead Army Guard assault commander;
translations.idiomatic: second, assault commanders of the Left and Right Lead Army Guards;

sentences.zh: 第三，左右領軍衛果毅：各一員。

translations.literal: Third, left right Lead Army Guard stalwart: each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: third, stalwarts of the Left and Right Lead Army Guards: one officer each.

sentences.zh: 第一部，分於當禦廂之左右差後；

translations.literal: First section, divide at facing hall wing left right slightly rear;
translations.idiomatic: The first section was divided slightly to the rear on the left and right of the facing hall wing;

sentences.zh: 第二部，左在金輅之後西偏，右在象輅之後東偏；

translations.literal: Second section, left at gold carriage behind west side, right at elephant carriage behind east side;
translations.idiomatic: the second section stood west behind the gold carriage on the left and east behind the elephant carriage on the right;

sentences.zh: 第三部，左在革輅之後西偏，右在木輅之後東偏，並北向。

translations.literal: Third section, left at leather carriage behind west side, right at wood carriage behind east side, together north face.
translations.idiomatic: the third section stood west behind the leather carriage on the left and east behind the wood carriage on the right, all facing north.

sentences.zh: 次左右廂各三部：第一，左右武衛將軍；

translations.literal: Next left right wing each three sections: first, left right Martial Guard generals;
translations.idiomatic: Next, each left and right wing had three sections: first, generals of the Left and Right Martial Guards;

sentences.zh: 第二，左右屯衛將軍；

translations.literal: Second, left right Garrison Guard generals;
translations.idiomatic: second, generals of the Left and Right Garrison Guards;

sentences.zh: 第三，左右領軍衛折衝：各一員。

translations.literal: Third, left right Lead Army Guard assault commander: each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: third, assault commanders of the Left and Right Lead Army Guards: one officer each.

sentences.zh: 各在網子、鶡雞、貔旗之前，東西相向。

translations.literal: Each at net pi hawk chicken pi flags before, east west face each other.
translations.idiomatic: Each stood before the net, hawk-chicken, and pi banners, facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 左右廂各步甲十二隊：第一隊，左右衛果毅；

translations.literal: Left right wing each foot armor twelve teams: first team, left right Guard stalwart;
translations.idiomatic: Each wing had twelve teams of foot soldiers in armor: first team, stalwarts of the Left and Right Guards;

sentences.zh: 第二，左右衛，第四，左右驍衛，第六，左右武衛，第八，左右屯衛，第十、第十二，左右領軍衛，並折衝；

translations.literal: Second, left right Guard, fourth, left right Martial Guard, sixth, left right Martial Guard, eighth, left right Garrison Guard, tenth twelfth, left right Lead Army Guard, together assault commander;
translations.idiomatic: second, the Left and Right Guards; fourth, the Left and Right Martial Guards; sixth, again the Left and Right Martial Guards; eighth, the Left and Right Garrison Guards; tenth and twelfth, the Left and Right Lead Army Guards—all with assault commanders;

sentences.zh: 第三，左右驍衛，第五，左右武衛，第七，左右屯衛，第九、第十一，左右領軍衛，並果毅：各一員。

translations.literal: Third, left right Martial Guard, fifth, left right Martial Guard, seventh, left right Garrison Guard, ninth eleventh, left right Lead Army Guard, together stalwart: each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: third, the Left and Right Martial Guards; fifth, again the Left and Right Martial Guards; seventh, the Left and Right Garrison Guards; ninth and eleventh, the Left and Right Lead Army Guards—all with stalwart officers, one each.

sentences.zh: 每隊旗一，貔、鶡雞、仙鹿、金鸚鵡、瑞麥、孔雀、野馬、犛牛、甘露、網子。

translations.literal: Each team flag one, pi hawk chicken immortal deer gold parrot auspicious wheat peacock wild horse yak sweet dew net.
translations.idiomatic: Each team had one banner: pi, hawk-chicken, immortal deer, golden parrot, auspicious wheat, peacock, wild horse, yak, sweet dew, or net.

sentences.zh: 〈（內第十二隊旗同第一隊。）〉

translations.literal: (Within twelfth team flag same first team.)
translations.idiomatic: (The banner of the twelfth team was the same as that of the first team.)

sentences.zh: 刀盾、弓矢相間，分十二隊，每隊三十人，五重。

translations.literal: Sword shield bow arrow alternating, divide twelve teams, each team thirty persons, five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Swords and shields alternated with bows and arrows in twelve teams of thirty persons each, in five ranks.

sentences.zh: 第一至第六隊，在仗首第二部北；

translations.literal: First to sixth teams, at guard head second section north;
translations.idiomatic: The first through sixth teams stood north of the second section at the head of the guard formation;

sentences.zh: 第七至第十二隊，在仗首第二部南，東西相向。

translations.literal: Seventh to twelfth teams, at guard head second section south, east west face each other.
translations.idiomatic: the seventh through twelfth stood south of that second section, facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 左右廂後部各十二隊：第一、第二，左右衛；

translations.literal: Left right wing rear section each twelve teams: first second, left right Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Each rear section of the left and right wings had twelve teams: first and second, the Left and Right Guards;

sentences.zh: 第五至第七，左右武衛；

translations.literal: Fifth to seventh, left right Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: fifth through seventh, the Left and Right Martial Guards;

sentences.zh: 第十至第十二，左右領軍衛：並折衝。

translations.literal: Tenth to twelfth, left right Lead Army Guard: together assault commander.
translations.idiomatic: tenth through twelfth, the Left and Right Lead Army Guards—all with assault commanders.

sentences.zh: 第三、第四，左右驍衛；

translations.literal: Third fourth, left right Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: Third and fourth: the Left and Right Martial Guards;

sentences.zh: 第八、第九，左右屯衛：並果毅。

translations.literal: Eighth ninth, left right Garrison Guard: together stalwart.
translations.idiomatic: eighth and ninth: the Left and Right Garrison Guards—all with stalwart officers.

sentences.zh: 每隊旗二，角端、赤熊、兕、太平、馴犀、鵕鸃、騼騶、騶牙、蒼烏、白狼、龍馬、金牛。

translations.literal: Each team had two banners: jiaoduan, red bear, wild bull, Great Peace, tame rhinoceros, junyi, lushu, zouya, dark crow, white wolf, dragon-horse, and golden ox.
translations.idiomatic: Each team had two banners apiece: jiaoduan, red bear, wild bull, Great Peace, tame rhinoceros, junyi, lushu, zouya, dark crow, white wolf, dragon-horse, and golden ox.

sentences.zh: 次弩五人為一列，弓矢十人為二重，槊二十人為四重。

translations.literal: Next crossbow five persons one column, bow arrow ten persons two ranks, spear twenty persons four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Next, crossbows in columns of five; bows and arrows in two ranks of ten; spears in four ranks of twenty.

sentences.zh: 以上在大慶殿門外，第一至第四隊在前，第五至第八隊在後，第九至第十二隊又在後，東西相向。

translations.literal: Above at Great Celebration Hall gate outside, first to fourth teams front, fifth to eighth teams rear, ninth to twelfth teams again rear, east west face each other.
translations.idiomatic: The above stood outside the gate of Great Celebration Hall: the first through fourth teams in front, the fifth through eighth behind them, and the ninth through twelfth still farther back, facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 真武隊：金吾折衝都尉一員，仙童、真武、螣蛇、神龜旗各一，

translations.literal: True Warrior team: Golden Guard assault commander captain one officer, immortal child True Warrior flying serpent divine turtle flags each one,
translations.idiomatic: True Warrior team: one assault-commander captain of the Golden Guard, and one each of the immortal child, True Warrior, flying serpent, and divine turtle banners,

sentences.zh: 〈（執各一人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each held by one person.)
translations.idiomatic: (each held by one person.)

sentences.zh: 暴槊二人，弩五人為一列，弓矢二十人為四重，槊二十五人為五重。

translations.literal: Violent spear two persons, crossbow five persons one column, bow arrow twenty persons four ranks, spear twenty-five persons five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: two bearers of violent spears; crossbows in columns of five; bows and arrows in four ranks of twenty; spears in five ranks of twenty-five.

sentences.zh: 以上在大慶門外中道，北向排列。

translations.literal: Above at Great Celebration gate outside central path, north face array.
translations.idiomatic: The above were arrayed on the central path outside Great Celebration Gate, facing north.

sentences.zh: 殿中省尚輦：陳孔雀扇四十於簾外。

translations.literal: Palace Directorate Imperial Sedan Office: display peacock fans forty at curtain outside.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Sedan Office of the Palace Directorate displayed forty peacock fans outside the curtain.

sentences.zh: 〈（執各一人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each held by one person.)
translations.idiomatic: (Each held by one person.)

sentences.zh: 陳輦輿於龍墀。

translations.literal: Display sedan carriages at dragon terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Sedans and carriages were displayed on the dragon terrace.

sentences.zh: 大輦在東部，押、執、擎人二百二十有二人；

translations.literal: Great palanquin at east section, escort hold lift persons two hundred twenty two;
translations.idiomatic: The great palanquin stood in the eastern section, with two hundred twenty-two escorts, bearers, and lifters;

sentences.zh: 腰輿在南，一十有七人；

translations.literal: Waist sedan at south, seventeen persons;
translations.idiomatic: the waist sedan to the south, with seventeen persons;

sentences.zh: 小輿又在南，二十有五人，皆西向。

translations.literal: Small sedan again south, twenty-five persons, all west face.
translations.idiomatic: the small sedan still farther south, with twenty-five persons—all facing west.

sentences.zh: 平輦在西，逍遙在南，共三十七人，皆東向。

translations.literal: Flat palanquin at west, leisure at south, together thirty-seven persons, all east face.
translations.idiomatic: The flat palanquin stood on the west, the leisure palanquin to the south—thirty-seven persons in all, all facing east.

sentences.zh: 設傘，扇於沙墀：方傘二，分左右；

translations.literal: Deploy umbrellas fans at sand terrace: square umbrella two, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: Umbrellas and fans were deployed on the sand terrace: two square umbrellas, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 〈（執傘將校四人。）〉

translations.literal: (Hold umbrella commanders four persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Four commanders holding umbrellas.)

sentences.zh: 團龍扇四，分左右；

translations.literal: Coiled dragon fans four, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: four coiled-dragon fans, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 〈（執扇都將四人。）〉

translations.literal: (Hold fan chief generals four persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Four chief generals holding fans.)

sentences.zh: 方雉扇一百，分傘、扇之後，為五行。

translations.literal: Square pheasant fans one hundred, divide umbrella fan behind, into five rows.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred square pheasant-tail fans, behind the umbrellas and fans, in five rows.

sentences.zh: 〈（執扇長行一百人。）〉

translations.literal: (Hold fan long formation one hundred persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (One hundred persons in the long formation holding fans.)

sentences.zh: 押當職掌二人，各立團龍扇之北。

translations.literal: Escort on-duty attendants two persons, each stand coiled dragon fan north.
translations.idiomatic: Two attendants on escort duty each stood north of the coiled-dragon fans.

sentences.zh: 金吾引駕官二人，分立團扇之南。

translations.literal: Golden Guard lead imperial carriage officers two persons, separate stand round fan south.
translations.idiomatic: Two Golden Guard officers leading the imperial carriage stood separately south of the round fans.

sentences.zh: 文德殿入閤之製，唯殿中省細仗，與兩省供奉官班於庭。

translations.literal: Wende Hall enter cabinet system, only Palace Directorate fine guard, with two provinces tribute officials rank at court.
translations.idiomatic: For the system of entering the privy chamber at Wende Hall, only the Palace Directorate's fine guard formation was used, with the ranked officials of the two provinces on tribute duty in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 太宗淳化三年，增黃麾仗二百五十人。

translations.literal: Taizong Chunhua year three, increase yellow banner guard two hundred fifty persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chunhua under Emperor Taizong, the yellow-banner guard was increased by two hundred fifty persons.

sentences.zh: 神宗熙寧三年，修閤門儀製宋敏求言：“本朝惟入閤乃禦文德殿視朝。

translations.literal: Shenzong Xining year three, repair Gate Office ritual system Song Minqiu stated: "Our dynasty only entering cabinet then hold Wende Hall view court.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xining under Emperor Shenzong, when revising the ritual system of the Gate Office, Song Minqiu stated: "In our dynasty the emperor held court at Wende Hall only when entering the privy chamber.

sentences.zh: 今既不用入閤儀，即文德殿遂闕視朝之禮。

translations.literal: Now since not use enter cabinet ritual, then Wende Hall thus lack view court rite.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the privy-chamber ritual is no longer used, Wende Hall accordingly lacks the rite of viewing court.

sentences.zh: 乞下兩製及太常禮院，約唐禦宣政殿製裁定，以備朔望正衙視朝之禮。”

translations.literal: Beg submit two drafting offices and Grand Ritual Court, follow Tang hold Xuanzheng Hall system fix decide, to prepare new moon full moon main hall view court rite."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the two drafting offices and the Grand Ritual Court be instructed, following the Tang system for holding court at Xuanzheng Hall, to fix and decide regulations so as to provide the rite of viewing court at the main hall on the new and full moon."

sentences.zh: 詔學士院詳定。

translations.literal: Edict Academy of Scholarly Worthies detailed fix.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Academy of Scholarly Worthies to detail and fix it.

sentences.zh: 學士韓維等上其儀：朔前一日，有司供張於文德殿庭。

translations.literal: Academician Han Wei etc. submit its ritual: new moon previous day, responsible officials supply display at Wende Hall court.
translations.idiomatic: Academician Han Wei and others submitted its ritual: on the day before the new moon, the responsible officials would supply and display [the formation] in the courtyard of Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 東面，左金吾引駕官一人，四色官二人，各帶儀刀。

translations.literal: East side, left Golden Guard lead imperial carriage officer one person, four-color officers two persons, each carry ritual blade.
translations.idiomatic: On the east: one officer of the Left Golden Guard leading the imperial carriage, two four-color officers, each bearing a ritual blade.

sentences.zh: 被金甲天武官一人，判殿中省一人，排列官一人。

translations.literal: Wear gold armor Heaven Martial officer one person, judge Palace Directorate one person, array officer one person.
translations.idiomatic: One Heaven Martial officer in gold armor, one judge of the Palace Directorate, and one array officer.

sentences.zh: 扇二，方傘一。

translations.literal: Fans two, square umbrella one.
translations.idiomatic: Two fans and one square umbrella.

sentences.zh: 金吾仗碧襴十二，各執儀刀。

translations.literal: Golden Guard guard azure brocade twelve, each hold ritual blade.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve azure-brocade [items] of the Golden Guard guard, each bearer holding a ritual blade.

sentences.zh: 兵部儀仗排列職掌一人，押隊員僚二人。

translations.literal: Ministry of War ritual accoutrements array duty attendant one person, escort team member aides two persons.
translations.idiomatic: One duty attendant for arraying the Ministry of War ritual accoutrements and two member aides escorting the team.

sentences.zh: 黃麾幡一，告止幡、傳教幡、信幡各八，龍頭竿、戟各五十。

translations.literal: Yellow banner pennant one, halt teaching trust pennants each eight, dragon-head pole halberd each fifty.
translations.idiomatic: One yellow-banner pennant; eight each of halt, teaching, and trust pennants; fifty dragon-head poles and fifty halberds.

sentences.zh: 西面，右金吾引駕官以下，皆如東面。

translations.literal: West side, right Golden Guard lead imperial carriage officer below, all like east side.
translations.idiomatic: On the west, the right Golden Guard lead-imperial-carriage officer and those below him were all as on the east.

sentences.zh: 天武官東西總百人。

translations.literal: Heaven Martial officers east west altogether one hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven Martial officers totaled one hundred persons east and west.

sentences.zh: 門外立仗：其東，青龍旗一，五嶽旗五，五龍旗十；

translations.literal: Gate outside standing guard: its east, Azure Dragon flag one, Five Peaks flags five, five dragon flags ten;
translations.idiomatic: Standing guard outside the gate: on the east, one Azure Dragon banner, five Five Peaks banners, and ten five-dragon banners;

sentences.zh: 其西，白虎旗一，五星旗五，五鳳旗十。

translations.literal: Its west, White Tiger flag one, Five Stars flags five, five phoenix flags ten.
translations.idiomatic: on the west, one White Tiger banner, five Five Stars banners, and ten five-phoenix banners.

sentences.zh: 禦馬，東西皆五匹，每匹人員二人，禦龍官四人。

translations.literal: Imperial horses, east west all five each, each horse personnel two persons, imperial dragon officers four persons.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial horses: five on each side; two attendants per horse and four imperial-dragon officers.

sentences.zh: 設禦幄於殿後閤。

translations.literal: Deploy imperial canopy at hall rear privy chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial canopy was set up in the privy chamber behind the hall.

sentences.zh: 其日，左右金吾將軍常服押本衛仗，殿中省官押細仗，東西對列，俟皇帝受朝、降坐、放仗，乃退。

translations.literal: That day, left right Golden Guard generals ordinary dress escort own guard, Palace Directorate officials escort fine guard, east west face row, wait emperor receive court descend seat release guard, then withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Left and Right Golden Guard generals in ordinary dress escorted their own guard formations; Palace Directorate officials escorted the fine guard; they stood facing each other east and west until the emperor had received court, left the seat, and the guard was dismissed—then they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 徽宗政和三年，議禮局上文德殿視朝之製：

translations.literal: Huizong Zhenghe year three, discuss ritual office submit Wende Hall view court system:
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenghe under Emperor Huizong, the Office for Discussing Rituals submitted the system for viewing court at Wende Hall:

sentences.zh: 黃麾半仗，共二千二百六十五人。

translations.literal: Yellow banner half guard, altogether two thousand two hundred sixty-five persons.
translations.idiomatic: Half yellow-banner guard formation: two thousand two hundred sixty-five persons in all.

sentences.zh: 殿內仗首，左右廂各一部，每部一百二十四人，在金吾仗南，東西相向。

translations.literal: Hall within guard head, left right wing each one section, each section one hundred twenty-four persons, at Golden Guard guard south, east west face each other.
translations.idiomatic: Within the hall, at the head of the guard: each wing had one section of one hundred twenty-four persons south of the Golden Guard formation, facing each other east and west.

sentences.zh: 絳引幡十，

translations.literal: Crimson guide pennants ten,
translations.idiomatic: Ten crimson guide pennants,

sentences.zh: 〈（執各一人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each held by one person.)
translations.idiomatic: (Each held by one person.)

sentences.zh: 分部之南北，為五重。

translations.literal: Divide section south north, into five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: divided north and south within the section into five ranks.

sentences.zh: 當禦廂左右部同，左部在帥兵官東，右部在帥兵官西，各為十重。

translations.literal: Facing hall wing left right sections same, left section at lead troop officer east, right section at lead troop officer west, each into ten ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right sections at the facing hall wing were the same: the left section stood east of the lead-troop officer and the right section west of him, each in ten ranks.

sentences.zh: 左右領軍衛大將軍各一員，居部之中。

translations.literal: Left right Lead Army Guard great generals each one officer, dwell section middle.
translations.idiomatic: One great general each of the Left and Right Lead Army Guards stood in the middle of the section.

sentences.zh: 〈（次廂左右第一、第二、第三部同。）〉

translations.literal: (Next wing left right first second third sections same.)
translations.idiomatic: (The next wing's first, second, and third sections on left and right were the same.)

sentences.zh: 掌鼓一人，次大將軍後。

translations.literal: Beat drum one person, next great general behind.
translations.idiomatic: One drum beater stood behind the great general.

sentences.zh: 〈（次廂左右第一部並當禦廂左右部，次果毅，次廂左右第二、第三部，次折衝，次後廂左右部，次將軍。）〉

translations.literal: (Next wing left right first section and facing hall wing left right sections, next stalwart, next wing left right second third sections, next assault commander, next rear wing left right sections, next generals.)
translations.idiomatic: (Next wing left right first section and facing-hall-wing left right sections: next stalwarts; next wing left right second and third sections: next assault commanders; next rear wing left right sections: next generals.)

sentences.zh: 帥兵官十人，分部之南北，為五重，北在絳引幡之南，南在絳引幡之北。

translations.literal: Lead troop officers ten persons, divide section south north into five ranks, north at crimson guide pennants south, south at crimson guide pennants north.
translations.idiomatic: Ten lead-troop officers, divided north and south within the section into five ranks—north of the southern crimson guide pennants and south of the northern crimson guide pennants.

sentences.zh: 次廂左右第一、第二、第三部在部之南北，當禦廂、次後廂左部在黃氅東，右部在黃氅西。

translations.literal: Next wing left right first second third sections at section south north, facing hall wing next rear wing left section at yellow streamer east, right section at yellow streamer west.
translations.idiomatic: The first, second, and third sections of the next wing stood north and south within the section; the left section of the facing hall wing and rear wing stood east of the yellow streamer and the right section west of it.

sentences.zh: 執儀刀部十行，行十人，每色兩行，為五重。

translations.literal: Hold ritual blade section ten rows, row ten persons, each color two rows, into five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Ten rows in the section bearing ritual blades, ten persons per row, two rows per color, forming five ranks.

sentences.zh: 〈（次廂左右第一、第二、第三部同。

translations.literal: (Next wing left right first second third sections same.
translations.idiomatic: (The next wing's first, second, and third sections on left and right were the same.

sentences.zh: 當禦廂、次後廂左右部，每色一行，為十重。

translations.literal: Facing hall wing next rear wing left right sections, each color one row, into ten ranks.
translations.idiomatic: At the facing hall wing and rear wing left and right sections, one row per color, forming ten ranks.

sentences.zh: 左部以東為首，右部以西為首，並次帥兵官。）〉

translations.literal: Left section east as head, right section west as head, together next lead troop officer.)
translations.idiomatic: The left section took the east as its head and the right section the west as its head, all next to the lead-troop officer.)

sentences.zh: 第一行，龍頭竿黃雞四角氅；

translations.literal: First row, dragon-head pole yellow chicken four-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: First row: four-corner streamers with yellow chickens on dragon-head poles;

sentences.zh: 〈（凡氅皆持以龍頭竿。）〉

translations.literal: (All streamers all held with dragon-head pole.)
translations.idiomatic: (All streamers were held on dragon-head poles.)

sentences.zh: 第二，儀鍠五色幡；

translations.literal: Second, ritual gong five-color pennants;
translations.idiomatic: Second: five-colored pennants with ritual gongs;

sentences.zh: 第三，青孔雀五角氅；

translations.literal: Third, azure peacock five-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Third: five-corner streamers with azure peacocks;

sentences.zh: 第四，烏戟；

translations.literal: Fourth, black halberd;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: black halberds;

sentences.zh: 第五，緋鳳六角氅；

translations.literal: Fifth, scarlet phoenix six-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: six-corner streamers with scarlet phoenixes;

sentences.zh: 第六，細弓矢；

translations.literal: Sixth, fine bow arrows;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: fine bows and arrows;

sentences.zh: 第七，白鵝四角氅；

translations.literal: Seventh, white goose four-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: four-corner streamers with white geese;

sentences.zh: 第八，朱縢絡盾刀；

translations.literal: Eighth, vermilion cord net shield sword;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth: swords with vermilion-cord net shields;

sentences.zh: 第九，皂鵝六角氅；

translations.literal: Ninth, black goose six-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Ninth: six-corner streamers with black geese;

sentences.zh: 第十，槊。

translations.literal: Tenth, spear.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth: spears.

sentences.zh: 揭鼓二，掌揭鼓二人。

translations.literal: Reveal drum two, hold reveal drum two persons.
translations.idiomatic: Two reveal drums and two persons to beat them.

sentences.zh: 〈（分立緋氅、烏戟後當中，次廂左右第一、第二、第三部同，當禦廂、次後廂並一在儀鍠、青氅間，一在弓矢、白氅間，與後行齊。）〉

translations.literal: (Separate stand scarlet streamer black halberd behind middle, next wing left right first second third sections same, facing hall wing next rear wing both one between ritual gong azure streamer, one between bow arrow white streamer, with rear row level.)
translations.idiomatic: (Standing separately behind the middle of the scarlet streamer and black halberd rows; same for the next wing's first, second, and third sections; at the facing hall wing and rear wing, one [drum] between the ritual gong and azure streamer and one between the bows and white streamer, aligned with the rear row.)

sentences.zh: 次廂左右各三部，每部一百一十五人，次左右廂仗首之南，東西相向。

translations.literal: Next wing left right each three sections, each section one hundred fifteen persons, next left right wing guard head south, east west face each other.
translations.idiomatic: Each next wing had three sections of one hundred fifteen persons each, south of the head sections of the left and right wings, facing each other.

sentences.zh: 第一部，左右屯衛大將軍及果毅各一員。

translations.literal: First section, left right Garrison Guard great generals and stalwarts each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: First section: one great general and one stalwart each of the Left and Right Garrison Guards.

sentences.zh: 第二部，左右武衛大將軍，第三部，左右衛將軍各一員，折衝各一員。

translations.literal: Second section, left right Martial Guard great generals, third section, left right Guard generals each one officer, assault commanders each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: Second section: great generals of the Left and Right Martial Guards; third section: one general each of the Left and Right Guards and one assault commander each.

sentences.zh: 黃麾幡二，分立當禦左右廂前中間，北向。

translations.literal: Yellow banner pennants two, separate stand facing hall left right wing front middle, north face.
translations.idiomatic: Two yellow-banner pennants stood separately in the middle before the left and right wings where the emperor faced court, facing north.

sentences.zh: 當禦廂左右各一部，每部一百二十四人，在殿門內中道，分東西，並北向。

translations.literal: Facing hall wing left right each one section, each section one hundred twenty-four persons, at hall gate within central path, divide east west, together north face.
translations.idiomatic: At the facing hall wing, one section on each side of one hundred twenty-four persons each stood within the hall gate on the central path, divided east and west, all facing north.

sentences.zh: 〈（次後廂左右部同。

translations.literal: (Next rear wing left right sections same.
translations.idiomatic: (The next rear wing's left and right sections were the same.

sentences.zh: 大慶殿列於樂架之南。）〉

translations.literal: Great Celebration Hall array at music frame south.)
translations.idiomatic: At Great Celebration Hall they were arrayed south of the music stands.)

sentences.zh: 左右衛果毅各一員。

translations.literal: Left right Guard stalwarts each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: One stalwart each of the Left and Right Guards.

sentences.zh: 〈（左在部西，右在部東。

translations.literal: (Left at section west, right at section east.
translations.idiomatic: (The left stood west of the section and the right east of it.

sentences.zh: 次後左右廂將軍準此。）〉

translations.literal: Next rear left right wing generals follow this.)
translations.idiomatic: Generals of the next rear left and right wings followed this rule.)

sentences.zh: 次後廂左右各一部，每部一百一十四人，次當禦廂南，左右驍衛將軍各一員。

translations.literal: Next rear wing left right each one section, each section one hundred fourteen persons, next facing hall wing south, left right Martial Guard generals each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: Each rear wing had one section of one hundred fourteen persons south of the facing hall wing, with one general each of the Left and Right Martial Guards.

sentences.zh: 左右廂各步軍六隊，

translations.literal: Left right wing each foot soldiers six teams,
translations.idiomatic: Each wing had six teams of foot soldiers,

sentences.zh: 〈（第一隊，每隊三十三人，第二至第六隊，每隊各二十七人。）〉

translations.literal: (First team, each team thirty-three persons, second to sixth teams, each team each twenty-seven persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (the first team thirty-three persons each; the second through sixth teams twenty-seven persons each.)

sentences.zh: 分東西，在仗隊後。

translations.literal: Divide east west, at guard team behind.
translations.idiomatic: divided east and west behind the guard teams.

sentences.zh: 第一，左右衛；

translations.literal: First, left right Guard;
translations.idiomatic: First: the Left and Right Guards;

sentences.zh: 第三，左右武衛；

translations.literal: Third, left right Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: third: the Left and Right Martial Guards;

sentences.zh: 第五，左右領軍衛：並果毅，各一員。

translations.literal: Fifth, left right Lead Army Guard: together stalwart, each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: fifth: the Left and Right Lead Army Guards—all with stalwart officers, one each.

sentences.zh: 第二，左右驍衛；

translations.literal: Second, left right Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: second: the Left and Right Martial Guards;

sentences.zh: 第四，左右屯衛；

translations.literal: Fourth, left right Garrison Guard;
translations.idiomatic: fourth: the Left and Right Garrison Guards;

sentences.zh: 第六，左右領軍衛：並折衝，各一員。

translations.literal: Sixth, left right Lead Army Guard: together assault commander, each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: sixth: the Left and Right Lead Army Guards—all with assault commanders, one each.

sentences.zh: 每隊旗二，貔、金鸚鵡、瑞麥、犛牛、甘露、鶡雞。

translations.literal: Each team flag two, pi gold parrot auspicious wheat yak sweet dew hawk chicken.
translations.idiomatic: Each team had two banners: pi, golden parrot, auspicious wheat, yak, sweet dew, and hawk-chicken.

sentences.zh: 〈（執各一人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each held by one person.)
translations.idiomatic: (Each held by one person.)

sentences.zh: 刀盾、弓矢相間，人數行列同前。

translations.literal: Sword shield bow arrow alternating, personnel rows same as before.
translations.idiomatic: Swords and shields alternated with bows and arrows; numbers and ranks were as before.

sentences.zh: 左右廂步軍，殿門外左右廂後部各六隊，每隊三十八人，在部下親從後，東西相向。

translations.literal: Left right wing foot soldiers, hall gate outside left right wing rear section each six teams, each team thirty-eight persons, at section below personal followers behind, east west face each other.
translations.idiomatic: Foot soldiers of the left and right wings: outside the hall gate, each rear section of each wing had six teams of thirty-eight persons behind the personal followers below the section, facing each other.

sentences.zh: 第一隊，左右衛；

translations.literal: First team, left right Guard;
translations.idiomatic: First team: the Left and Right Guards;

sentences.zh: 第三，左右武衛；

translations.literal: Third, left right Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: third: the Left and Right Martial Guards;

sentences.zh: 第五，左右領軍衛：並折衝，各一員，第二，左右驍衛；

translations.literal: Fifth, left right Lead Army Guard: together assault commander, each one officer, second, left right Martial Guard;
translations.idiomatic: fifth: the Left and Right Lead Army Guards—with assault commanders, one each; second: the Left and Right Martial Guards;

sentences.zh: 第四、第六，左右屯衛：並果毅，各一員。

translations.literal: Fourth sixth, left right Garrison Guard: together stalwart, each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: fourth and sixth: the Left and Right Garrison Guards—all with stalwart officers, one each.

sentences.zh: 角端、太平、馴犀、騶牙、白狼、蒼烏等旗各二，弩五人，為一列，弓矢十人，為二重，槊二十人，為四重。

translations.literal: Two banners each for jiaoduan, Great Peace, tame rhinoceros, zouya, white wolf, dark crow, and the like; five crossbowmen formed one column, ten archers made two ranks, and twenty spearmen made four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: There were two banners each for jiaoduan, Great Peace, tame rhinoceros, zouya, white wolf, dark crow, and similar figures; crossbowmen stood five to a column, archers ten in two ranks, and spearmen twenty in four ranks.

sentences.zh: 真武隊五十七人，在端禮門內中道，北向。

translations.literal: True Warrior team fifty-seven persons, at Duanli Gate within central path, north face.
translations.idiomatic: True Warrior team: fifty-seven persons on the central path inside Duanli Gate, facing north.

sentences.zh: 〈（大慶殿於殿門外。）〉

translations.literal: (Great Celebration Hall at hall gate outside.)
translations.idiomatic: (At Great Celebration Hall, outside the hall gate.)

sentences.zh: 前有金吾折衝都尉一員，仙童、真武、螣蛇、神龜等旗各一，暴槊二人，弩五人為一列，弓矢二十人為四重，槊二十五人為五重。

translations.literal: Front have Golden Guard assault commander captain one officer, immortal child True Warrior flying serpent divine turtle etc. flags each one, violent spear two persons, crossbow five persons one column, bow arrow twenty persons four ranks, spear twenty-five persons five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In front were one assault-commander captain of the Golden Guard; one each of the immortal child, True Warrior, flying serpent, and divine turtle banners; two bearers of violent spears; crossbows in columns of five; bows and arrows in four ranks of twenty; spears in five ranks of twenty-five.

sentences.zh: 排列仗隊職掌六人，分立仗隊之間，殿內四人，殿外二人。

translations.literal: Array guard team duty attendants six persons, separate stand guard teams between, hall within four persons, hall outside two persons.
translations.idiomatic: Six duty attendants for arraying the guard teams stood among the teams—four within the hall and two outside.

sentences.zh: 殿中省尚輦陳扇二十於簾外，執扇殿侍二十人。

translations.literal: Palace Directorate Imperial Sedan display fans twenty at curtain outside, hold fan hall attendants twenty persons.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Sedan Office of the Palace Directorate displayed twenty fans outside the curtain, with twenty hall attendants holding fans.

sentences.zh: 陳腰輿、小輿於東、西朵殿，腰輿在東，小輿在西，人員、都將各一人，輦官共四十人。

translations.literal: Display waist sedan small sedan at east west side halls, waist sedan east, small sedan west, personnel chief generals each one person, sedan officers altogether forty persons.
translations.idiomatic: Waist and small sedans were displayed in the eastern and western side halls—the waist sedan on the east and the small sedan on the west—with one chief general each for personnel and forty sedan officers in all.

sentences.zh: 陳傘、扇於殿下，方傘二，團龍扇四，並分左右夾傘。

translations.literal: Display umbrellas fans at hall below, square umbrella two, coiled dragon fans four, together divide left right flank umbrella.
translations.idiomatic: Umbrellas and fans were displayed below the hall: two square umbrellas and four coiled-dragon fans, flanking the umbrellas left and right.

sentences.zh: 〈（執扇各一人，將校或節級。）〉

translations.literal: (Hold fan each one person, commanders or section chiefs.)
translations.idiomatic: (Each fan held by one person—a commander or section chief.)

sentences.zh: 方雉扇六十，作三重，在傘、扇之後。

translations.literal: Square pheasant fans sixty, make three ranks, at umbrella fan behind.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty square pheasant-tail fans in three ranks behind the umbrellas and fans.

sentences.zh: 輦官長行各一人，金吾左右將軍各一員，在傘、扇之南，稍前。

translations.literal: Sedan officer long formation each one person, Golden Guard left right generals each one officer, at umbrella fan south, slightly front.
translations.idiomatic: One person in the long formation for sedan officers; one general each of the Left and Right Golden Guards—slightly forward, south of the umbrellas and fans.

sentences.zh: 四色官四人，二人立於將軍之南，與傘、扇一列。

translations.literal: Four-color officers four persons, two persons stand at generals south, with umbrella fan one row.
translations.idiomatic: Four four-color officers; two stood south of the generals in one row with the umbrellas and fans.

sentences.zh: 宣敕放仗二人，在引駕官南。

translations.literal: Announce edict release guard two persons, at lead imperial carriage officer south.
translations.idiomatic: Two officers to announce the edict and release the guard stood south of the lead-imperial-carriage officers.

sentences.zh: 執儀刀引駕官二人，在親從官後。

translations.literal: Hold ritual blade lead imperial carriage officers two persons, at personal follower officers behind.
translations.idiomatic: Two lead-imperial-carriage officers bearing ritual blades stood behind the personal-follower officers.

sentences.zh: 長行二十四人，在四色官之南。

translations.literal: Long formation twenty-four persons, at four-color officers south.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four persons in the long formation stood south of the four-color officers.

sentences.zh: 排列官二人，在長行之南。

translations.literal: Array officers two persons, at long formation south.
translations.idiomatic: Two array officers stood south of the long formation.

sentences.zh: 次金甲天武官二人，在長行南。

translations.literal: Next gold armor Heaven Martial officers two persons, at long formation south.
translations.idiomatic: Next, two Heaven Martial officers in gold armor stood south of the long formation.

sentences.zh: 以上並分東西相向立。

translations.literal: Above all together divide east west face each other stand.
translations.idiomatic: All the above stood facing each other, divided east and west.

sentences.zh: 設旗於殿門之外，青龍旗一在左，五嶽神旗各一次之，五方色龍旗各一次之，五方色龍旗各一又次之。

translations.literal: Deploy flags at hall gate outside, Azure Dragon flag one at left, Five Peaks spirit flags each one next, five direction color dragon flags each one next, five direction color dragon flags each one again next.
translations.idiomatic: Flags were deployed outside the hall gate: one Azure Dragon banner on the left; one each of the Five Peaks spirit banners next; then one each of the five-direction colored dragon banners, and again one each of the five-direction colored dragon banners.

sentences.zh: 白虎旗一在右，五星神旗各一次之，五方色鳳旗各一次之，五方色鳳旗各一又次之。

translations.literal: White Tiger flag one at right, Five Stars spirit flags each one next, five direction color phoenix flags each one next, five direction color phoenix flags each one again next.
translations.idiomatic: One White Tiger banner on the right; one each of the Five Stars spirit banners next; then one each of the five-direction colored phoenix banners, and again one each of the five-direction colored phoenix banners.

sentences.zh: 詔頒行之。

translations.literal: Edict promulgate execute it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that it be promulgated and put into practice.

sentences.zh: 〈（大慶殿冊命諸王、大臣，黃麾仗準文德殿視朝。）〉

translations.literal: (Great Celebration Hall investiture book appoint various kings great ministers, yellow banner guard follow Wende Hall view court.)
translations.idiomatic: (For investiture by book of kings and great ministers at Great Celebration Hall, the yellow-banner guard followed the Wende Hall court-audience standard.)

sentences.zh: 政和中，大祀饗立仗：大黃龍負圖旗一，執糸斥二百人，陳於闕庭赤龍旗南少西大黃龍旗之北。

translations.literal: Zhenghe middle, great sacrifice feast standing guard: great yellow dragon bearing diagram flag one, hold banner streamers two hundred persons, display at gate court red dragon flag south slightly west great yellow dragon flag north.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenghe era, standing guard at the great sacrificial feast: one great yellow dragon bearing-diagram banner, two hundred bearers, displayed in the gate courtyard slightly west of the red dragon banner and north of the great yellow dragon banner.

sentences.zh: 宣和冬祀，陳於大內前。

translations.literal: Xuanhe winter sacrifice, display at great inner front.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter sacrifice in the Xuanhe era, they were displayed before the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 大黃龍旗一，執糸斥六十人，陳於逐頓宮門外宣德門，次大黃龍負圖旗之南。

translations.literal: Great yellow dragon flag one, hold banner streamers sixty persons, display at each halt palace gate outside Xuande Gate, next great yellow dragon bearing diagram flag south.
translations.idiomatic: One great yellow dragon banner with sixty bearers, displayed outside Xuande Gate at each palace halt, south of the great yellow dragon bearing-diagram banner.

sentences.zh: 宣和，此旗下又有日、月、五星連珠、北斗、招搖、蒼龍、白虎、朱雀、玄武、君王萬歲、獅子、金鸞、金鳳、五方龍、天下太平等旗，凡二十一。

translations.literal: Xuanhe, under this banner again have sun moon five stars linked pearl Northern Dipper Twinkling azure dragon white tiger vermilion bird black warrior monarch ten thousand years lion golden luan golden phoenix five direction dragon under heaven great peace etc. flags, altogether twenty-one.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xuanhe era, below this banner there were also twenty-one banners in all: sun, moon, Five Stars Linked as Pearls, Northern Dipper, Twinkling, azure dragon, white tiger, vermilion bird, black warrior, My Lord Ten Thousand Years, lion, golden luan, golden phoenix, five-direction dragons, Great Peace Under Heaven, and others.

sentences.zh: 正、至受朝同。

translations.literal: New Year solstice receive court same.
translations.idiomatic: The same arrangement applied for receiving court on New Year's Day and the winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 龍墀旗陳於殿庭；

translations.literal: Dragon terrace flags display at hall court;
translations.idiomatic: Dragon-terrace banners were displayed in the hall courtyard;

sentences.zh: 太廟，在西欞星門外路南，次赤龍旗少北；

translations.literal: Grand Ancestral Temple, at west Lattice Star gate outside road south, next red dragon flag slightly north;
translations.idiomatic: at the Grand Ancestral Temple, south of the road outside the west Lattice Star Gate, slightly north of the red dragon banner;

sentences.zh: 青城，在泰禋門外，夏祭大禮在明禋門外。

translations.literal: Green city, at Great Submission gate outside, summer sacrifice great rite at Bright Submission gate outside.
translations.idiomatic: at the Green City, outside the Great Submission Gate, and for the summer great rite outside the Bright Submission Gate.

sentences.zh: 赤龍旗之南。

translations.literal: Red dragon flag south.
translations.idiomatic: south of the red dragon banner.

sentences.zh: 〈（宗祀祫饗大禮，不設大黃龍負圖旗、大黃龍旗。）〉

translations.literal: (Ancestral sacrifice joint feast great rite, not deploy great yellow dragon bearing diagram flag great yellow dragon flag.)
translations.idiomatic: (For the great rite of ancestral sacrifice and joint feast, the great yellow dragon bearing-diagram banner and great yellow dragon banner were not deployed.)

sentences.zh: 大神旗六，執糸斥各九十人，宣德門、泰禋門並陳於大黃龍旗之南，東西相望；

translations.literal: Great spirit flags six, hold banner streamers each ninety persons, Xuande Gate Great Submission Gate together display at great yellow dragon flag south, east west face each other;
translations.idiomatic: Six great spirit banners, ninety bearers each, displayed south of the great yellow dragon banner at Xuande Gate and Great Submission Gate, facing each other east and west;

sentences.zh: 大廟陳於西欞星門外，大黃龍旗之西少南，視赤龍旗為列，南北相望。

translations.literal: Grand Temple display at west Lattice Star gate outside, great yellow dragon flag west slightly south, regard red dragon flag as row, south north face each other.
translations.idiomatic: at the Grand Temple, outside the west Lattice Star Gate, slightly southwest of the great yellow dragon banner, in rows measured against the red dragon banner, facing each other north and south.

sentences.zh: 龍墀旗執糸斥各十二人，左右有日、月旗各一。

translations.literal: Dragon terrace flags hold banner streamers each twelve persons, left right have sun moon flags each one.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon-terrace banners: twelve bearers each; to left and right, one sun banner and one moon banner each.

sentences.zh: 次君王萬歲旗一，宣德門、泰禋門，在路東；

translations.literal: Next monarch ten thousand years flag one, Xuande Gate Great Submission Gate, at road east;
translations.idiomatic: Next, one My Lord Ten Thousand Years banner—east of the road at Xuande Gate and Great Submission Gate;

sentences.zh: 太廟，在門外路南。

translations.literal: Grand Temple, at gate outside road south.
translations.idiomatic: at the Grand Temple, south of the road outside the gate.

sentences.zh: 次獅子旗二，左右有金鸞、金鳳旗各一。

translations.literal: Next lion flags two, left right have golden luan golden phoenix flags each one.
translations.idiomatic: Next, two lion banners; to left and right, one golden luan banner and one golden phoenix banner each.

sentences.zh: 次五方龍旗各一：青、黃、赤龍旗，宣德、泰禋門在東，太廟在南；

translations.literal: Next five direction dragon flags each one: azure yellow vermilion dragon flags, Xuande Great Submission gates at east, Grand Temple at south;
translations.idiomatic: Next, one dragon banner for each of the five directions: azure, yellow, and vermilion dragon banners east at Xuande and Great Submission Gates and south at the Grand Temple;

sentences.zh: 黑、白龍旗，宣德、泰禋門在西，太廟在北。

translations.literal: Black white dragon flags, Xuande Great Submission gates at west, Grand Temple at north.
translations.idiomatic: black and white dragon banners west at Xuande and Great Submission Gates and north at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 次天下太平旗一，宣德、泰禋門，在路西；

translations.literal: Next under heaven great peace flag one, Xuande Great Submission gates, at road west;
translations.idiomatic: Next, one Great Peace Under Heaven banner—west of the road at Xuande and Great Submission Gates;

sentences.zh: 太廟，在路北。

translations.literal: Grand Temple, at road north.
translations.idiomatic: at the Grand Temple, north of the road.

sentences.zh: 以上旗皆在車駕前發仗內。

translations.literal: Above flags all at imperial carriage front deploy guard within.
translations.idiomatic: All the above banners were within the guard formation deployed before the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 執糸斥人並錦帽、五色絁繡寶相花衫、鐵臂鞲、革帶。

translations.literal: Hold banner streamers persons together brocade cap five-color gauze embroidered treasure flower shirt iron arm guard leather belt.
translations.idiomatic: Bearers all wore brocade caps, five-colored gauze shirts embroidered with treasure flowers, iron arm guards, and leather belts.

sentences.zh: 政和中，遼使朝紫宸殿，用黃麾角仗，共一千五十六人。

translations.literal: Zhenghe middle, Liao envoy court Purple Hall Hall, use yellow banner corner guard, altogether one thousand fifty-six persons.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhenghe, when Liao envoys attended court at Purple Hall Hall, the yellow-banner corner guard was used—one thousand fifty-six persons in all.

sentences.zh: 殿內黃麾幡二，次四色官之南，分左右。

translations.literal: Hall within yellow banner pennants two, next four-color officers south, divide left right.
translations.idiomatic: Within the hall, two yellow-banner pennants stood south of the four-color officers, divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 仗首左右廂各一部，每部一百四十人，在朵殿下稍南。

translations.literal: Guard head left right wing each one section, each section one hundred forty persons, at side hall below slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: At the head of the guard, each wing had one section of one hundred forty persons, slightly south of the side halls.

sentences.zh: 絳引幡十，分部之南北，各為五重。

translations.literal: Crimson guide pennants ten, divide section south north, each into five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Ten crimson guide pennants, divided north and south within the section, each into five ranks.

sentences.zh: 左右領軍衛大將軍各一員，在部中稍南。

translations.literal: Left right Lead Army Guard great generals each one officer, at section middle slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: One great general each of the Left and Right Lead Army Guards stood slightly south of the center of the section.

sentences.zh: 〈（次廂左右第一、第二部同。）〉

translations.literal: (Next wing left right first second sections same.)
translations.idiomatic: (The next wing's first and second sections on left and right were the same.)

sentences.zh: 掌鼓一人，次大將軍後。

translations.literal: Beat drum one person, next great general behind.
translations.idiomatic: One drum beater stood behind the great general.

sentences.zh: 〈（次廂左右第一部次果毅，第二部次折衝。）〉

translations.literal: (Next wing left right first section next stalwart, second section next assault commander.)
translations.idiomatic: (Next wing left right first section: next stalwarts; second section: next assault commanders.)

sentences.zh: 帥兵官十人，分部之南北，

translations.literal: Lead troop officers ten persons, divide section south north,
translations.idiomatic: Ten lead-troop officers, divided north and south within the section,

sentences.zh: 〈（北在絳引幡之南，南在絳引幡之北。

translations.literal: (North at crimson guide pennants south, south at crimson guide pennants north.
