translations.idiomatic: (North of the southern crimson guide pennants and south of the northern crimson guide pennants.

sentences.zh: 次廂左右第一、第二部在部之南北。）〉

translations.literal: Next wing left right first second sections at section south north.)
translations.idiomatic: The next wing's first and second sections stood north and south within the section.)

sentences.zh: 各為五重。

translations.literal: Each into five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: each into five ranks.

sentences.zh: 執儀刀部九行，每行持各十人。

translations.literal: Hold ritual blade section nine rows, each row holders each ten persons.
translations.idiomatic: Nine rows in the section bearing ritual blades, ten holders in each row.

sentences.zh: 第一，龍頭竿黃雞四角氅；

translations.literal: First, dragon-head pole yellow chicken four-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: First: four-corner streamers with yellow chickens on dragon-head poles;

sentences.zh: 〈（皆持以龍頭竿。）〉

translations.literal: (All held with dragon-head pole.)
translations.idiomatic: (All held on dragon-head poles.)

sentences.zh: 第二，儀鍠五色幡；

translations.literal: Second, ritual gong five-color pennants;
translations.idiomatic: Second: five-colored pennants with ritual gongs;

sentences.zh: 第三，青孔雀五角氅；

translations.literal: Third, azure peacock five-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Third: five-corner streamers with azure peacocks;

sentences.zh: 第四，烏戟；

translations.literal: Fourth, black halberd;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: black halberds;

sentences.zh: 第五，緋鳳六角氅；

translations.literal: Fifth, scarlet phoenix six-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: six-corner streamers with scarlet phoenixes;

sentences.zh: 第六，細弓矢；

translations.literal: Sixth, fine bow arrows;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: fine bows and arrows;

sentences.zh: 第七，白鵝四角氅；

translations.literal: Seventh, white goose four-corner streamer;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: four-corner streamers with white geese;

sentences.zh: 第八，槊；

translations.literal: Eighth, spear;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth: spears;

sentences.zh: 第九，阜鵝六角氅。

translations.literal: Ninth, mound goose six-corner streamer.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth: six-corner streamers with mound geese.

sentences.zh: 掌揭鼓一人，在緋氅、烏戟之後。

translations.literal: Hold reveal drum one person, at scarlet streamer black halberd behind.
translations.idiomatic: One person to beat the reveal drum stood behind the scarlet streamer and black halberd rows.

sentences.zh: 〈（次廂左右第一、第二部同。）〉

translations.literal: (Next wing left right first second sections same.)
translations.idiomatic: (The next wing's first and second sections on left and right were the same.)

sentences.zh: 次廂左右各二部，每部一百五人，次左右廂仗首之南。

translations.literal: Next wing left right each two sections, each section one hundred five persons, next left right wing guard head south.
translations.idiomatic: Each next wing had two sections of one hundred five persons each, south of the head sections of the left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 第一部，左右屯衛大將軍、果毅各一員；

translations.literal: First section, left right Garrison Guard great generals stalwarts each one officer;
translations.idiomatic: First section: one great general and one stalwart each of the Left and Right Garrison Guards;

sentences.zh: 第二，左右武衛大將軍、折衝各一員。

translations.literal: Second, left right Martial Guard great generals assault commanders each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: second: one great general and one assault commander each of the Left and Right Martial Guards.

sentences.zh: 掌鼓以下至掌揭鼓人數，並同仗首。

translations.literal: Beat drum below to hold reveal drum personnel numbers, together same guard head.
translations.idiomatic: From the drum beater down to the reveal-drum personnel, the numbers were the same as at the head of the guard.

sentences.zh: 殿外左右廂各步甲三隊，每隊三十三人。

translations.literal: Hall outside left right wing each foot armor three teams, each team thirty-three persons.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the hall, each wing had three teams of armored foot soldiers, thirty-three persons per team.

sentences.zh: 第一，左右衛，第三，左右武衛，並果毅；

translations.literal: First, left right Guard, third, left right Martial Guard, together stalwart;
translations.idiomatic: First: the Left and Right Guards; third: the Left and Right Martial Guards—all with stalwart officers;

sentences.zh: 第二，左右驍衛、折衝：並各一員。

translations.literal: Second, left right Martial Guard assault commander: together each one officer.
translations.idiomatic: second: the Left and Right Martial Guards with assault commanders—one each.

sentences.zh: 貔、金鸚鵡、瑞麥旗各二，以次分在三隊。

translations.literal: Pi gold parrot auspicious wheat flags each two, in order divide at three teams.
translations.idiomatic: Two each of the pi, golden parrot, and auspicious wheat banners, distributed in order among the three teams.

sentences.zh: 刀盾三十人，為五重。

translations.literal: Sword shield thirty persons, into five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty with swords and shields, in five ranks.

sentences.zh: 〈（內第二隊弓矢。）〉

translations.literal: (Within second team bow arrow.)
translations.idiomatic: (Within the second team: bows and arrows.)

sentences.zh: 左右廂後部各三隊，

translations.literal: Left right wing rear section each three teams,
translations.idiomatic: Each rear section of the left and right wings had three teams,

sentences.zh: 〈（第一隊每隊三十八人，第二隊每隊三十三人。）〉

translations.literal: (First team each team thirty-eight persons, second team each team thirty-three persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (the first team thirty-eight persons each; the second team thirty-three persons each.)

sentences.zh: 第一，左右衛，第三，左右武衛，並折衝；

translations.literal: First, left right Guard, third, left right Martial Guard, together assault commander;
translations.idiomatic: First: the Left and Right Guards; third: the Left and Right Martial Guards—all with assault commanders;

sentences.zh: 第二，左右驍衛、果毅。

translations.literal: Second, left right Martial Guard stalwart.
translations.idiomatic: second: the Left and Right Martial Guards with stalwart officers.

sentences.zh: 角端、太平、馴犀旗各二，以次分在三隊。

translations.literal: Two banners each for jiaoduan, Great Peace, and tame rhinoceros were distributed in order among the three teams.
translations.idiomatic: Two banners each for jiaoduan, Great Peace, and tame rhinoceros were assigned in sequence to the three teams.

sentences.zh: 弩五人，為一列，弓矢十人，為二重，

translations.literal: Crossbow five persons one column, bow arrow ten persons two ranks,
translations.idiomatic: Crossbows in columns of five; bows and arrows in two ranks of ten;

sentences.zh: 〈（第二、第三隊為一列。）〉

translations.literal: (Second third teams one column.)
translations.idiomatic: (the second and third teams in one column.)

sentences.zh: 槊二十人，為四重。

translations.literal: Spear twenty persons four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: spears in four ranks of twenty.

sentences.zh: 排列仗隊職掌二人，次廂第二部之南，分左右。

translations.literal: Array guard team duty attendants two persons, next wing second section south, divide left right.
translations.idiomatic: Two duty attendants for arraying the guard teams stood south of the second section of the next wing, divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 以上殿內外仗隊，東西相向排列。

translations.literal: Above hall inside outside guard teams, east west face each other array.
translations.idiomatic: All guard teams inside and outside the hall were arrayed facing each other east and west.

sentences.zh: 殿中省尚輦陳輿、輦於東西朵殿，平輦在東，西向；

translations.literal: Palace Directorate Imperial Sedan display carriages sedans at east west side halls, flat palanquin east, west face;
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Sedan Office displayed carriages and sedans in the eastern and western side halls—the flat palanquin on the east, facing west;

sentences.zh: 逍遙輦在西，東向。

translations.literal: Leisure palanquin west, east face.
translations.idiomatic: the leisure palanquin on the west, facing east.

sentences.zh: 設傘、扇於殿下，方傘二，分左右；

translations.literal: Deploy umbrellas fans at hall below, square umbrella two, divide left right;
translations.idiomatic: Umbrellas and fans were deployed below the hall: two square umbrellas, divided left and right;

sentences.zh: 團龍扇四，分左右，夾方傘。

translations.literal: Coiled dragon fans four, divide left right, flank square umbrella.
translations.idiomatic: four coiled-dragon fans, divided left and right, flanking the square umbrellas.

sentences.zh: 方雉扇二十四，分左右，各二重，在傘、扇之後。

translations.literal: Square pheasant fans twenty-four, divide left right, each two ranks, at umbrella fan behind.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four square pheasant-tail fans, divided left and right in two ranks each, behind the umbrellas and fans.

sentences.zh: 金吾四色官一人。

translations.literal: Golden Guard four-color officer one person.
translations.idiomatic: One four-color officer of the Golden Guard.

sentences.zh: 政和中，文德殿發冊，用黃麾細仗，共一千四百二人。

translations.literal: Zhenghe middle, Wende Hall issue book, use yellow banner fine guard, altogether one thousand four hundred two persons.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhenghe, when issuing the investiture book at Wende Hall, the fine yellow-banner guard was used—one thousand four hundred two persons in all.

sentences.zh: 設日旗、君王萬歲旗、獅子旗、金鸞旗、青龍旗、赤龍旗各一，在殿東階之東，以西為上；

translations.literal: Deploy sun flag monarch ten thousand years flag lion flag golden luan flag azure dragon flag vermilion dragon flag each one, at hall east steps east, take west as upper;
translations.idiomatic: One each of the sun, My Lord Ten Thousand Years, lion, golden luan, azure dragon, and vermilion dragon banners were deployed east of the eastern steps of the hall, taking west as the place of honor;

sentences.zh: 月旗、天下太平旗、獅子旗、金鳳旗、白龍旗、黑龍旗各一，在殿西階之西，以東為上；

translations.literal: Moon flag under heaven great peace flag lion flag golden phoenix flag white dragon flag black dragon flag each one, at hall west steps west, take east as upper;
translations.idiomatic: one each of the moon, Great Peace Under Heaven, lion, golden phoenix, white dragon, and black dragon banners west of the western steps, taking east as the place of honor;

sentences.zh: 〈（每旗執扯四人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each flag hold pull four persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Four persons to hold and guide each banner.)

sentences.zh: 俱北向立。

translations.literal: Together north face stand.
translations.idiomatic: All stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 押當職掌二人，分左右立於日、月旗南。

translations.literal: Escort on-duty attendants two persons, divide left right stand at sun moon flags south.
translations.idiomatic: Two attendants on escort duty stood left and right south of the sun and moon banners.

sentences.zh: 次方傘二，團龍扇四，夾方傘。

translations.literal: Next square umbrella two, coiled dragon fans four, flank square umbrella.
translations.idiomatic: Next, two square umbrellas and four coiled-dragon fans flanking the square umbrellas.

sentences.zh: 次金吾上將軍二人，將軍四人，引駕官四人。

translations.literal: Next Golden Guard upper generals two persons, generals four persons, lead imperial carriage officers four persons.
translations.idiomatic: Next, two upper generals of the Golden Guard, four generals, and four lead-imperial-carriage officers.

sentences.zh: 次金甲二人。

translations.literal: Next gold armor two persons.
translations.idiomatic: Next, two persons in gold armor.

sentences.zh: 次四色官六人，內二人執笏，餘執金銅儀刀。

translations.literal: Next four-color officers six persons, within two persons hold hu, remainder hold gold copper ritual blade.
translations.idiomatic: Next, six four-color officers—two holding court tablets, the rest holding gold and copper ritual blades.

sentences.zh: 次碧襴二十四人，內執金銅儀刀左右各六人，在北。

translations.literal: Next azure brocade twenty-four persons, within hold gold copper ritual blade left right each six persons, at north.
translations.idiomatic: Next, twenty-four in azure brocade, including six on each side bearing gold and copper ritual blades, at the north.

sentences.zh: 次都押衙二人，立於碧襴之南，少退。

translations.literal: Next chief escort yamen two persons, stand at azure brocade south, slightly withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Next, two chief escort officers stood south of the azure brocade, slightly to the rear.

sentences.zh: 次皂纛旗一十二，

translations.literal: Next black banners twelve,
translations.idiomatic: Next, twelve black great banners,

sentences.zh: 〈（每旗執扯五人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each flag hold pull five persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Five persons to hold and guide each banner.)

sentences.zh: 左右金吾仗司員僚各一人押纛，立於旗南。

translations.literal: Left right Golden Guard guard office member aides each one person escort banners, stand at flag south.
translations.idiomatic: One member aide each from the Left and Right Golden Guard guard offices escorted the banners, standing south of the flags.

sentences.zh: 次青龍旗一在東，白虎旗一在西，

translations.literal: Next Azure Dragon flag one at east, White Tiger flag one at west,
translations.idiomatic: Next, one Azure Dragon banner on the east and one White Tiger banner on the west,

sentences.zh: 〈（每旗執扯六人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each flag hold pull six persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Six persons to hold and guide each banner.)

sentences.zh: 員僚二人押旗，在旗之北。

translations.literal: Member aides two persons escort flags, at flag north.
translations.idiomatic: Two member aides escorted the flags, standing north of them.

sentences.zh: 以上並分左右，東西向。

translations.literal: Above all together divide left right, east west face.
translations.idiomatic: All the above were divided left and right, facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 次五方龍旗在東，五方鳳旗在西，各二十五。

translations.literal: Next five direction dragon flags at east, five direction phoenix flags at west, each twenty-five.
translations.idiomatic: Next, twenty-five dragon banners of the five directions on the east and twenty-five phoenix banners of the five directions on the west.

sentences.zh: 每五旗相間，各依方色排列。

translations.literal: Each five flags alternating, each according direction color array.
translations.idiomatic: Every five banners alternated, each arrayed according to its directional color.

sentences.zh: 次五嶽神旗五在東，五星神旗五在西，各依方位排列。

translations.literal: Next Five Peaks spirit flags five at east, Five Stars spirit flags five at west, each according direction position array.
translations.idiomatic: Next, five Five Peaks spirit banners on the east and five Five Stars spirit banners on the west, each arrayed according to directional position.

sentences.zh: 〈（每旗執扯三人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each flag hold pull three persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Three persons to hold and guide each banner.)

sentences.zh: 次朱雀旗一在東，真武旗一在西。

translations.literal: Next Vermilion Bird flag one at east, True Warrior flag one at west.
translations.idiomatic: Next, one Vermilion Bird banner on the east and one True Warrior banner on the west.

sentences.zh: 〈（每旗執扯六人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each flag hold pull six persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Six persons to hold and guide each banner.)

sentences.zh: 以上並北向。

translations.literal: Above all together north face.
translations.idiomatic: All the above faced north.

sentences.zh: 員僚二人押旗，在旗之南，分左右。

translations.literal: Member aides two persons escort flags, at flag south, divide left right.
translations.idiomatic: Two member aides escorted the flags, standing south of them, divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 次紅門旗二十八，分左右。

translations.literal: Next Red Gate flags twenty-eight, divide left right.
translations.idiomatic: Next, twenty-eight Red Gate banners, divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 〈（每旗執扯二人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each flag hold pull two persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Two persons to hold and guide each banner.)

sentences.zh: 次寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未旗六，在東；

translations.literal: Next Yin Mao Chen Si Wu Wei flags six, at east;
translations.idiomatic: Next, six banners for Yin, Mao, Chen, Si, Wu, and Wei, on the east;

sentences.zh: 申、酉、戌、亥、子、醜旗六，在西。

translations.literal: Shen You Xu Hai Zi Chou flags six, at west.
translations.idiomatic: six banners for Shen, You, Xu, Hai, Zi, and Chou, on the west.

sentences.zh: 天王旗四，分左右，夾辰旗。

translations.literal: Heaven King flags four, divide left right, flank Chen flag.
translations.idiomatic: Four Heaven King banners, divided left and right, flanking the Chen banner.

sentences.zh: 次龍君、赤豹、吏兵旗各五，每旗各為一列在東，每列掩尾天馬旗一，以次在東。

translations.literal: Next Dragon Lord red leopard official soldier flags each five, each flag each one column at east, each column tail-cover heaven horse flag one, in order at east.
translations.idiomatic: Next, five each of the dragon lord, red leopard, and official-soldier banners—each banner in its own column on the east, each column with one heaven horse banner at its tail, arrayed in order on the east.

sentences.zh: 次虎君、黃熊、力士旗各五，每旗各為一列在西，每列掩尾天馬旗一，以次在西。

translations.literal: Next Tiger Lord yellow bear strongman flags each five, each flag each one column at west, each column tail-cover heaven horse flag one, in order at west.
translations.idiomatic: Next, five each of the tiger lord, yellow bear, and strongman banners—each in its own column on the west, each with one heaven horse banner at its tail, arrayed in order on the west.

sentences.zh: 〈（每旗執扯三人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each flag hold pull three persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Three persons to hold and guide each banner.)

sentences.zh: 員僚六人押仗，各分立旗前。

translations.literal: Member aides six persons escort guard, each separate stand flag front.
translations.idiomatic: Six member aides escorted the guard, each standing separately before a flag.

sentences.zh: 次員僚四人押旗，分左右，東西為一列。

translations.literal: Next member aides four persons escort flags, divide left right, east west one column.
translations.idiomatic: Next, four member aides escorted the flags, divided left and right in one column east and west.

sentences.zh: 〈（每列一員。）〉

translations.literal: (Each column one officer.)
translations.idiomatic: (One officer per column.)

sentences.zh: 左廂第一隊，鶡雞、白澤、玉馬、貔旗、四瀆旗各一，為一列；

translations.literal: Left wing first team, hawk chicken white marsh jade horse pi banner four streams flags each one, one column;
translations.idiomatic: Left wing, first team: one column of one each of the hawk-chicken, white marsh, jade horse, pi, and Four Streams banners;

sentences.zh: 〈（下至第九隊旗行列準此。）〉

translations.literal: (Below to ninth team flag row column follow this.)
translations.idiomatic: (The flag rows and columns of the teams below the ninth followed this pattern.)

sentences.zh: 第二隊，角、亢、氐、房、心宿旗各一；

translations.literal: Second team, Horn Succeeding Base Room Heart lodge flags each one;
translations.idiomatic: Second team: one each of the Horn, Succeeding, Base, Room, and Heart lodge banners;

sentences.zh: 第三隊，虛、危、室、壁、奎宿旗各一；

translations.literal: Third team, Emptiness Rooftop House Wall Stride lodge flags each one;
translations.idiomatic: Third team: one each of the Emptiness, Rooftop, House, Wall, and Stride lodge banners;

sentences.zh: 第四隊，參、井、鬼、柳宿、駃騠旗各一；

translations.literal: Fourth team, Three Well Ghost Willow lodges swift colt flag each one;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth team: one each of the Three, Well, Ghost, and Willow lodge banners and the swift colt banner;

sentences.zh: 第五隊，三角獸、黃鹿、苣文、馴象、飛麟旗各一；

translations.literal: Fifth team, triangle beast yellow deer juwen tame elephant flying qilin flags each one;
translations.idiomatic: Fifth team: one each of the triangle beast, yellow deer, juwen, tame elephant, and flying qilin banners;

sentences.zh: 第六隊，辟邪、玉兔、吉利、仙鹿、祥雲旗各一；

translations.literal: Sixth team, ward evil jade rabbit auspicious profit immortal deer auspicious cloud flags each one;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth team: one each of the ward-off-evil, jade rabbit, auspicious profit, immortal deer, and auspicious cloud banners;

sentences.zh: 第七隊，花鳳、飛黃、野馬、金鸚鵡、瑞麥旗各一；

translations.literal: Seventh team, flower phoenix flying yellow wild horse gold parrot auspicious wheat flags each one;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh team: one each of the flower phoenix, flying yellow, wild horse, golden parrot, and auspicious wheat banners;

sentences.zh: 第八隊，孔雀、兕、甘露、網子、角端旗各一，並各為一列；

translations.literal: The eighth team had one banner each for peacock, wild bull, sweet dew, net, and jiaoduan, each forming its own column;
translations.idiomatic: The eighth team had one each of the peacock, wild bull, sweet dew, net, and jiaoduan banners, each in its own column;

sentences.zh: 第九隊，犛牛旗一，設於孔雀旗後。

translations.literal: Ninth team, yak banner one, deploy at peacock flag behind.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth team: one yak banner, deployed behind the peacock banner.

sentences.zh: 右廂第一隊，同左廂第一；

translations.literal: Right wing first team, same left wing first;
translations.idiomatic: Right wing, first team: the same as the left wing's first team;

sentences.zh: 第二隊，尾、箕、鬥、牛、女宿旗各一；

translations.literal: Second team, Tail Winnow Dipper Ox Woman lodge flags each one;
translations.idiomatic: second team: one each of the Tail, Winnow, Dipper, Ox, and Woman lodge banners;

sentences.zh: 第三隊，婁、胃、昴、畢、觜宿旗各一；

translations.literal: Third team, Bond Stomach Hairy Net Beak lodge flags each one;
translations.idiomatic: third team: one each of the Bond, Stomach, Hairy, Net, and Beak lodge banners;

sentences.zh: 第四隊，星、張、翼、軫、駃騠旗各一；

translations.literal: Fourth team, Star Extended Wing Chariot swift colt flags each one;
translations.idiomatic: fourth team: one each of the Star, Extended, Wing, and Chariot lodge banners and the swift colt banner;

sentences.zh: 第五至第八隊，並同左廂第五至第八；

translations.literal: Fifth to eighth teams, together same left wing fifth to eighth;
translations.idiomatic: fifth through eighth teams: the same as the left wing's fifth through eighth;

sentences.zh: 第九隊，騶牙旗、蒼烏旗各二，相間為一列。

translations.literal: Ninth team, zouya banner dark crow banners each two, alternating one column.
translations.idiomatic: ninth team: two each of the zouya and dark crow banners, alternating in one column.

sentences.zh: 〈（每旗執扯三人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each flag hold pull three persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Three persons to hold and guide each banner.)

sentences.zh: 俱北向。

translations.literal: Together north face.
translations.idiomatic: All faced north.

sentences.zh: 員僚二人，押黃麾立於龍鳳旗之北。

translations.literal: Member aides two persons, escort yellow banner stand at dragon phoenix flags north.
translations.idiomatic: Two member aides escorted the yellow banner, standing north of the dragon and phoenix banners.

sentences.zh: 左右廂五色龍鳳旗之東西，各設黃麾幡二。

translations.literal: Left right wing five color dragon phoenix flags east west, each deploy yellow banner pennants two.
translations.idiomatic: East and west of the five-colored dragon and phoenix banners of each wing, two yellow-banner pennants were deployed.

sentences.zh: 次告止幡、傳教幡、信幡各五，次絳麾幡二，次絳引幡五。

translations.literal: Next halt teaching trust pennants each five, next crimson banner pennants two, next crimson guide pennants five.
translations.idiomatic: Next, five each of halt, teaching, and trust pennants; next, two crimson-banner pennants; next, five crimson guide pennants.

sentences.zh: 員僚五人，押黃麾立於龍鳳旗北少東。

translations.literal: Member aides five persons, escort yellow banner stand at dragon phoenix flags north slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: Five member aides escorted the yellow banner, standing slightly east of north of the dragon and phoenix banners.

sentences.zh: 排闌旗三十，自黃麾幡東西排列，以次於南，

translations.literal: Gate-clearing flags thirty, from yellow banner pennants east west array, in order at south,
translations.idiomatic: Thirty gate-clearing banners, arrayed east and west from the yellow-banner pennants, in order toward the south,

sentences.zh: 〈（每旗執扯三人。）〉

translations.literal: (Each flag hold pull three persons.)
translations.idiomatic: (Three persons to hold and guide each banner.)

sentences.zh: 俱北向。

translations.literal: Together north face.
translations.idiomatic: All faced north.

sentences.zh: 鐙杖、哥舒各三十，於殿東西兩廂排列。

translations.literal: Stirrup staff Geshu each thirty, at hall east west two wings array.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty stirrup staffs and thirty Geshu [poles] each, arrayed in the two wings east and west of the hall.

sentences.zh: 鐙杖起北，哥舒間之，俱東西相向。

translations.literal: Stirrup staff start north, Geshu between them, together east west face each other.
translations.idiomatic: Stirrup staffs began from the north with Geshu between them, all facing each other east and west.

sentences.zh: 左右廂執白柯槍各七十五人，東西相向。

translations.literal: Left right wing hold white ke spears each seventy-five persons, east west face each other.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-five bearers of white ke spears on each wing, facing each other east and west.

sentences.zh: 又於騶牙旗南設大黃龍旗一，在殿門裏少西，執扯二十人。

translations.literal: Again at zouya banner south deploy great yellow dragon flag one, at hall gate inside slightly west, hold pull twenty persons.
translations.idiomatic: Again south of the zouya banner one great yellow dragon banner was deployed slightly west inside the hall gate, with twenty bearers.

sentences.zh: 小黃龍旗一，在大黃龍旗後少西，執扯三人。

translations.literal: Small yellow dragon flag one, at great yellow dragon flag behind slightly west, hold pull three persons.
translations.idiomatic: One small yellow dragon banner slightly west behind the great yellow dragon banner, with three bearers.

sentences.zh: 次大神旗六，分左右。

translations.literal: Next great spirit flags six, divide left right.
translations.idiomatic: Next, six great spirit banners, divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 衛尉寺押當儀仗職掌四人，排仗通直官二人，大將二人，節級二人，檢察六人，左右金吾仗司押當職掌、排列官各一人。

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Insignia escort on-duty ritual accoutrements duty attendants four persons, deploy guard direct officers two persons, great generals two persons, section chiefs two persons, inspectors six persons, left right Golden Guard guard office escort on-duty attendants array officers each one person.
translations.idiomatic: Four duty attendants of the Court of Imperial Insignia for on-duty ritual accoutrements; two direct officers for deploying the guard; two great generals; two section chiefs; six inspectors; and one each of the on-duty attendants and array officers of the Left and Right Golden Guard guard offices.

sentences.zh: 職掌、大將、檢察。

translations.literal: Duty attendants great generals inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: Duty attendants, great generals, and inspectors.

sentences.zh: 凡大朝會儀衛，有司皆依令式陳設。

translations.literal: All great court assembly ceremonial guard, responsible offices all according decree form display.
translations.idiomatic: For all great court assembly ceremonial guards, the responsible offices displayed them according to the prescribed decree forms.

sentences.zh: 初，宋製，有黃麾大仗、半仗、角仗、細仗。

translations.literal: Initially, Song system, had yellow banner great guard half guard corner guard fine guard.
translations.idiomatic: Initially under the Song system there were the great, half, corner, and fine yellow-banner guard formations.

sentences.zh: 南渡後，儀仗尤簡，惟造黃麾半仗、角仗、細仗，而大仗不設。

translations.literal: South crossing after, ceremonial guard especially simple, only made yellow banner half guard corner guard fine guard, yet great guard not deploy.
translations.idiomatic: After the move south, ceremonial guards were especially simplified: only the half, corner, and fine yellow-banner formations were made, and the great formation was no longer deployed.

sentences.zh: 中興大朝會，四朝惟一講，紹興十五年正月朔旦是也。

translations.literal: Restoration great court assembly, four court assemblies only one full ceremony, Shaoxing fifteen year first month new year day dawn was it.
translations.idiomatic: For great court assemblies after the Restoration, of four court occasions only one full ceremony was held—that of the new-year dawn on the first day of the first month in the fifteenth year of Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 然止以大仗三分減一，用三千三百五十人。

translations.literal: Yet only with great guard three parts reduce one, use three thousand three hundred fifty persons.
translations.idiomatic: Yet even this used only two-thirds of the great guard—three thousand three hundred fifty persons.

sentences.zh: 自是正旦、冬至俱免大朝賀，以為定例焉。

translations.literal: From this New Year winter solstice all exempt great court felicitation, to be fixed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: From this, great court felicitations on New Year's Day and the winter solstice were both waived, becoming fixed precedent.

sentences.zh: 黃麾半仗者，大慶殿正旦受朝、兩宮上冊寶之所設也，用二千四百一十五人。

translations.literal: Yellow banner half guard, Great Celebration Hall New Year receive court two palaces upward investiture seal what deploy, use two thousand four hundred fifteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: The half yellow-banner guard, deployed when receiving court on New Year's Day at Great Celebration Hall and when the two palaces presented investiture seals, used two thousand four hundred fifteen persons.

sentences.zh: 其內儀仗官兵等一千八百三人，兵部職掌五人，統製官二人，皆襆頭、公裳、腰帶、靴、笏。

translations.literal: Its within ritual accoutrements military officials etc. one thousand eight hundred three persons, Ministry of War duty attendants five persons, overall command officers two persons, all futou official robes waist belt boots hu.
translations.idiomatic: Within it were one thousand eight hundred three ritual-accoutrement military officials; five Ministry of War duty attendants; and two overall command officers—all in futou, official robes, waist belts, boots, and court tablets.

sentences.zh: 金吾司碧襴三十二人，襆頭、碧襴衫、銅革帶，執儀刀。

translations.literal: Golden Guard office azure brocade thirty-two persons, futou azure brocade shirt leather belt, hold ritual blade.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two persons of the Golden Guard office in azure brocade, with futou, azure-brocade shirts, and leather belts, bearing ritual blades.

sentences.zh: 將官二人，襆頭、緋抹額、紫繡羅袍、背螣蛇、銅革帶，執儀刀。

translations.literal: General officers two persons, futou scarlet forehead band purple embroidered silk robe back flying serpent copper leather belt, hold ritual blade.
translations.idiomatic: Two general officers in futou, scarlet forehead bands, purple embroidered silk robes with flying serpent on the back, and copper leather belts, bearing ritual blades.

sentences.zh: 旁頭一十人，素帽、紫紬衫、纈衫、黃勒帛，執銅仗子。

translations.literal: Side attendants ten persons, plain cap purple gauze shirt patterned shirt yellow waist sash, hold copper staff.
translations.idiomatic: Ten side attendants in plain caps, purple gauze shirts, patterned shirts, and yellow waist sashes, bearing copper staffs.

sentences.zh: 金銅甲二人，兜鍪、甲衫、錦臂衣，執金銅鉞斧。

translations.literal: Gold copper armor two persons, helmet armor shirt brocade arm wrap, hold gold copper battle axe.
translations.idiomatic: Two in gold and copper armor, with helmets, armored shirts, and brocade arm wraps, bearing gold and copper battle-axes.

sentences.zh: 絳引幡十，告止幡、傳教幡、信幡各二，執幡人皆武弁、緋寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: Crimson guide pennants ten, halt teaching trust pennants each two, hold pennant persons all martial cap scarlet treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Ten crimson guide pennants; two each of halt, teaching, and trust pennants—all pennant bearers in martial caps, scarlet treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 黃麾幡二，執幡人武弁、黃寶相花衫、銅革帶。

translations.literal: Yellow banner pennants two, hold pennant persons martial cap yellow treasure flower shirt copper leather belt.
translations.idiomatic: Two yellow-banner pennants—bearers in martial caps, yellow treasure-flower shirts, and copper leather belts.

sentences.zh: 小行旗三百人，素帽、五色抹額、緋寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: Small marching flags three hundred persons, plain cap five-color forehead band scarlet treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred small marching flags: plain caps, five-colored forehead bands, scarlet treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 五色小氅三百人，儀鍠四十人，皆纈帽，五色寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: Five color small streamers three hundred persons, ritual gong forty persons, all patterned cap five-color treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred small streamers of five colors; forty ritual gongs—all in patterned caps, five-colored treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 金節一十二人，武弁、青寶相花衫、銅革帶。

translations.literal: Gold node twelve persons, martial cap azure treasure flower shirt copper leather belt.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve with gold nodes: martial caps, azure treasure-flower shirts, and copper leather belts.

sentences.zh: 殳叉三十人，素帽、五色寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: Shu fork thirty persons, plain cap five-color treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty with shu forks: plain caps, five-colored treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 綠槊二百一十人，素帽、緋寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: Green spear two hundred ten persons, plain cap scarlet treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred ten with green spears: plain caps, scarlet treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 烏戟二百一十人，纈帽、緋寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: Black halberd two hundred ten persons, patterned cap scarlet treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred ten with black halberds: patterned caps, scarlet treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 白柯槍六十人，素帽子、銀褐寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: White ke spear sixty persons, plain cap silver brown treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty with white ke spears: plain caps, silver-brown treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 儀弓二百七十人，纈帽、青寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: Ritual bow two hundred seventy persons, patterned cap azure treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred seventy with ritual bows: patterned caps, azure treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 儀弩六十人，平巾幘、緋寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: Ritual crossbow sixty persons, flat kerchief cap scarlet treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty with ritual crossbows: flat kerchief caps, scarlet treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 銅仗子二十人，素帽、紫紬衫、黃勒帛。

translations.literal: Copper staff twenty persons, plain cap purple gauze shirt yellow waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty with copper staffs: plain caps, purple gauze shirts, and yellow waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 儀刀百八十四人，平巾幘、緋寶相花衫。

translations.literal: Ritual blade one hundred eighty-four persons, flat kerchief cap scarlet treasure flower shirt.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred eighty-four with ritual blades: flat kerchief caps and scarlet treasure-flower shirts.

sentences.zh: 內大旗下六百一十二人，大旗三十四，龍旗一十，鳳旗一十，五星旗、五嶽旗各五，青龍旗、白虎旗、朱雀旗、玄武旗各一，每旗扶拽一十七人，搭材一名，武弁、五色寶相花衫、勒帛。

translations.literal: Within great banners six hundred twelve persons, great banners thirty-four, dragon flags ten, phoenix flags ten, Five Stars flags Five Peaks flags each five, Azure Dragon White Tiger Vermilion Bird Black Warrior flags each one, each flag support pull seventeen persons, frame material one name, martial cap five-color treasure flower shirt waist sash.
translations.idiomatic: Within the great banners were six hundred twelve persons: thirty-four great banners; ten dragon and ten phoenix banners; five each of Five Stars and Five Peaks banners; one each of Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, and Black Warrior banners—seventeen support-and-guide persons per banner and one frame-material worker—all in martial caps, five-colored treasure-flower shirts, and waist sashes.

sentences.zh: 其外殿中輿輦、傘扇百三十三人，逍遙、平輦各一，每輦人員八人，帽子、宜男纈羅單衫、塗金銀柘枝腰帶。

translations.literal: Its outside Palace Directorate sedan carriages umbrellas fans one hundred thirty-three persons, leisure flat palanquin each one, each palanquin personnel eight persons, cap suitable male patterned silk single shirt gilded silver branch waist belt.
translations.idiomatic: Outside this were one hundred thirty-three persons for sedans, carriages, umbrellas, and fans of the Palace Directorate—one leisure and one flat palanquin, eight personnel each, in caps, suitable-male patterned silk single shirts, and gilded-silver branch waist belts.

sentences.zh: 輦官二十七人，襆頭、白獅子纈羅單衫、塗金銀海捷腰帶、紫羅裏夾三襜。

translations.literal: Sedan officers twenty-seven persons, futou white lion patterned silk single shirt gilded silver sea victory waist belt purple silk lining three flap.
